ga: Kɛ mikɛ ŋmɔshi nibii krokomɛi wo kookoo ŋmɔ ko ni yɔɔ hewalɛ mli lɛ Ani mitsei lɛ baanyɛ adamɔ hela naa?

english: Fertilizer helps healthy trees grow strong and produce more yield, but it does not make them immune to viral diseases. Good farm hygiene and pest control are still required to keep your trees safe.
ga: Nibii ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ yeɔ ebuaa tsei ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ ni amɛdaraa waa ni amɛwoɔ ŋmɔshi nibii babaoo. Shi ehaaa helai ni jɛɔ helatsɛmɛi amli baa lɛ akaye onɔ. Okwaafoi amli hetsemɔ kpakpa kɛ tsɛŋemɔ helai ahe nitsumɔ hu he miihia koni otsei lɛ ahi shi shweshweeshwe.

english: How can I protect my young cocoa trees from catching diseases from nearby older farms?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ mabu cacao tsei bibii ahe kɛjɛ helai ni jɛ ŋmɔji momoi ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ amli lɛ ahe?

english: You can protect young trees by planting shade barrier crops like plantains around your farm borders to block pests, inspecting your farm regularly, and reporting early signs of disease right away.
ga: Obaanyɛ obu tsei bibii ahe. Abaanyɛ ana enɛ kɛtsɔ tsei ni haa hulu tsoɔ tamɔ plantains ni ooodu yɛ oŋmɔ lɛ naa koni ebu ohe kɛjɛ tsɛŋemɔ helai ahe lɛ nɔ. Kwɛmɔ oŋmɔ lɛ mli daa ni obɔ hela he okadii ni tsɔɔ mra lɛ he amaniɛ amrɔ nɔŋŋ

english: Yellowing lower leaves usually mean the crop lacks nitrogen, an essential plant food. Rain can wash nitrogen deep into the soil where roots cannot reach, so applying a nitrogen-rich fertilizer like NPK or Urea helps the plants grow green and strong again.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baa ni yɔɔ shishigbɛ ni ji ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ tso lɛ bɛ nitrogen, ni ji tso niyenii ni he hiaa waa lɛ. Nugbɔ baanyɛ ajie nitrogen lɛ kɛya shikpɔŋ lɛ mli shɔŋŋ yɛ he ni shishifãi nyɛŋ ashɛ he lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni nitrogen babaoo yɔɔ mli, tamɔ NPK loo urea tsu nii lɛ, ebaaye ebua tsei lɛ ni amɛfee ŋmɔji ni amɛhe wa ekoŋŋ.

english: What is making small holes in my young maize leaves and eating the stem from inside?
ga: Mɛni kɛ buji bibii ni yɔɔ mi-baby corn baai lɛ amli lɛ baa? Ni oye tso lɛ kɛjɛ mli?

english: This damage is caused by the Fall Armyworm caterpillar. They hide inside the central leaves of the maize plant, and treating the crop early with recommended biological or chemical controls stops them before they destroy the crop.
ga: Fall Armyworm ŋmeii lɛ kɛ fitemɔ nɛɛ baa. Amɛteɔ amɛhe amɛwoɔ ŋmãa tsei lɛ ateŋ baai lɛ amli. kɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni akɛtsuɔ nii mra ni akɛ tsofai loo tsofai ni akɛtsuɔ nii ni akɛkwɛɔ nɔ lɛ tsuɔ he nii mra. Tsi amɛ gbɛ dani amɛfite ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ.

english: Cocoa flowers drop when the tree is stressed by prolonged dry weather, lack of soil nutrients, or insect pests like mirids (capsids). Keeping proper shade trees and managing insect pests helps flowers stay attached and turn into healthy cocoa pods.
ga: Cocoa fɔfɔii lɛ shwieɔ shi kɛ́ kɔɔyɔŋ ni mli egbi be kakadaŋŋ lɛ hao tso lɛ. niyenii mli hewalɛ ni bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli loo kooloi ni yeɔ mɔ awui tamɔ mirids (capsids). Tso ni yɔɔ shade mli lɛ nɔkwɛmɔ ni sa kɛ tsɛŋemɔ helai ahe nitsumɔ yeɔ ebuaa fɔfɔi lɛ ni amɛkpɛtɛɔ amɛhe ni amɛfeɔ kookoo ŋmeii ni yɔɔ hewalɛ.

english: Why are my young cocoa pods turning black and rotting during the heavy rains?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-kokoo ŋmɔji bibii lɛ feɔ ediŋŋ ni amɛgboiɔ yɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ mli lɛ?

english: This is Black Pod disease, caused by a fungus that spreads rapidly through water splashes during rainy season. Pruning excess tree branches to let air and sunlight into the farm helps dry the pods and prevents the rot from spreading.
ga: Nɔ ni kɛ black pod hela baa ji tsɛŋemɔ hela ko ni gbɛɔ eshwaa oya kɛtsɔɔ nu mli nugbɔshiimɔi amli yɛ nugbɔshiimɔ be mli. Kɛ́ ofolɔ tsei niji ni fa fe nine lɛ koni kɔɔyɔɔ kɛ hulu la abote ŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni ŋmeii lɛ agbi ni ebaatsi ŋmeii ni shwereɔ lɛ anaa.

english: Cassava root rot is caused by excess water sitting in heavy soil or by soil-borne fungi. Planting your cassava on raised mounds or ridges helps excess water drain away so the roots remain healthy until harvest.
ga: Nu ni fa fe nine ni abua naa yɛ sũ ni tsii mli loo sũ mli ŋmeii kɛbaa. Kasava ni aduɔ yɛ gɔŋ loo ŋshɔkpɔ ni nɔ kwɔ nɔ lɛ haa nu ni fa fe nine lɛ hoɔ kɛyaa. Shishifãi lɛ hiɔ shi shiŋŋ kɛyashiɔ be mli ni akpaa.

english: Why are my planted yam setts taking a very long time to sprout out of the soil mounds?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ eheɔ be babaoo dani mi-sweet potato lɛ miikwɛ̃ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ?

english: Yam setts delay sprouting if the soil is too hot and dry, or if the seed tubers were planted before breaking their natural dormancy. Covering the mounds with dry grass (mulching) keeps the soil cool and moist to speed up sprouting.
ga: Sweet potatoes baaha ekwɛ̃mɔ aya hiɛ kɛji shikpɔŋ lɛ mli edɔ tsɔ ni egbi. Aloo kɛji akɛ adu dumɔwui lɛ ayitsei lɛ dani adebɔɔ mli wɔɔhe ba. Kɛ́ akɛ jwɛi ni egbi (mulch) ha gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ feɔ fɛ̃i ni ehaa ŋmɔtɔ baa.

english: Plantain trees fall easily because they have shallow roots, which can be weakened by tiny soil pests called nematodes or banana weevils. Ensuring healthy planting material and mounding soil around the base gives the roots stronger support.
ga: Dumɔwui lɛ gbeeɔ shi oya ejaakɛ amɛshishifãi lɛ mli ekɔɔɔ. Shikpɔŋ nɔ nibii bibii ni baa lɛ baanyɛ aha enɛ agbɔjɔ. Atsɛɔ lɛ hu akɛ nematodes loo banana ŋmeii. Kɛ́ aha nibii ni akɛduɔ lɛ ahi shi jogbaŋŋ, ni akɛ sũ ni ato shishi lɛ he lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa ni ewajeɔ shishifãi lɛ.

english: Tomato leaf curl is usually caused by a plant virus spread by tiny whitefly insects. Controlling whiteflies early and removing heavily infected plants keeps the disease from spreading to the rest of your garden.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, tso mli hela ko ni ŋmeii bibii yɛŋ gbɛɔ eshwaa lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ tomato baa lɛ shwieɔ shi. Whitefly Kudɔmɔ Mra ni ojie tsei ni hela emɔ amɛ waa lɛ. Enɛ baaye abua ni hela lɛ akagbɛ ashwã obɔɔ lɛ hei krokomɛi.

english: Why do my pepper plants keep dropping their small flowers before any peppers appear?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ shĩɔ fɔfɔi bibii dani pepper lɛ jeɔ kpo lɛ?

english: Pepper plants shed their flowers when the weather is too hot or when they don't get a steady supply of water. Regular, consistent watering helps cool the plant so it can turn flowers into peppers.
ga: Pepper tsei lɛ fɔɔ fɔfɔi kɛ́ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli edɔ tsɔ loo kɛ́ amɛnáaa nu daa. Nu ni afɔɔ tso lɛ nɔ daa, daa lɛ yeɔ ebuaa lɛ ni ehaa tso lɛ mli jɔɔ, ni ebaanyɛ etsɔ efɔfɔi lɛ amli ŋmɔtɔ.

english: Why is my cowpea field growing lots of leafy green leaves but very few seed pods?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cowpea ŋmɔ lɛ mli baa ŋmɔji babaoo yɔɔ lɛ? Shi dumɔwui ŋmɔji fioo pɛ yɔɔ.

english: When cowpeas receive too much nitrogen fertilizer, they put all their energy into growing leaves instead of fruits. Using balanced fertilizers lower in nitrogen encourages the crop to produce flowers and pods instead.
ga: Kɛji tsina ŋmei nine shɛ nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii babaoo nɔ lɛ, ŋmei kɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ baatsu nii ni ekɛwo baai yɛ aduawai najiaŋ. Kɛ́ akɛ tsofa ni ja ni nitrogen faaa yɛ mli lɛ tsu nii lɛ, ebaawo tso lɛ hewalɛ ni ewo fɔfɔi kɛ ŋmeii moŋ.

english: Young cocoa plants cannot withstand direct, hot sunlight. They need shade crops like plantains or canopy trees above them to protect their delicate leaves from scorching until their root systems grow strong enough.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii lɛ nyɛŋ aŋmɛ hulu la ni mli edɔ ni tsoɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ gbɛ. Amɛmiitao tsei ni haa hulu tsoɔ tamɔ plantains loo tsei bibii ni yɔɔ tsei anɔ lɛ koni amɛbu baai ni yɔɔ mlɛo lɛ ahe kɛjɛ shãa he kɛyashi shishifãi lɛ amli baawa bɔ ni sa.

english: Yam vines need to reach up high to capture as much sunlight as possible. The leaves use sunlight to manufacture food, which is then sent back down underground to swell and grow large yam tubers.
ga: Ehe miihia ni sweet potato wain tsei lɛ ashɛ he ko ni nɔ kwɔ koni enyɛ emɔ hulu la babaoo bɔ ni eeenyɛ. Baai kɛ hulu la tsuɔ nii kɛ feɔ niyenii. No sɛɛ lɛ, akuɔ sɛɛ akɛyaa shikpɔŋ shishi koni eha sweet potato ŋmeii lɛ amli alɛɛ ni amɛdara.

english: Plantains have shallow roots that stay near the top of the soil rather than going deep. When the plant carries a heavy bunch of fruit, it becomes top-heavy and needs to be supported with a sturdy wooden prop to stay upright.
ga: Plantains lɛ shishifãi lɛ mli ekɔɔɔ, ni amɛbɛŋkɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ moŋ fe ni amɛbaafee nɔ ni mli kwɔ. Beni tso lɛ woɔ yibii babaoo Ebaafee nɔ ni tsii ni ehe baahia ni akɛ tsei ni wa afi sɛɛ koni ehi shi jaŋŋ.

english: Yellow leaves are a sign that your maize lacks nitrogen, an essential nutrient for plant growth. Heavy rains often wash nitrogen out of the soil, so applying fertilizer like NPK or compost will help restore their green color.
ga: Baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ lɛ ji okadi ni tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ o-abele lɛ mli. ni ji niyenii ni he hiaa kɛha tsei adalɛ Bei pii lɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ hoɔ nitrogen kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii tamɔ NPK loo ŋmɔshi nibii fata he lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni ekɛ ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ aku sɛɛ aba.

english: Why does my field yield smaller harvests when I plant maize on the exact same plot every year?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ miŋmɔ lɛ wooo yibii babaoo kɛ́ midu ŋmãa kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ daa afi lɛ?

english: Planting maize repeatedly in the same spot drains the exact same nutrients from the soil without giving the land time to recover. Rotating your maize with legumes like beans or groundnuts puts vital nitrogen back into the soil naturally.
ga: Abɛi ni aduɔ shii abɔ Yɛ he kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ejieɔ niyenii mli nibii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli ni ehaaa shikpɔŋ lɛ be ni ekɛbaatsake ehe. Abele ni akɛ ŋmeii tamɔ ŋmeii loo ŋmeii tsakeɔ lɛ baaha nitrogen ni he hiaa lɛ aku sɛɛ aba sũ lɛ mli yɛ adebɔɔ naa.

english: Cassava roots need air in the soil to breathe. When water sits in the ground for too long without draining, it suffocates the roots and encourages fungal diseases that cause rot, which is why planting on raised mounds helps.
ga: Cassava shishifãi lɛ taoɔ kɔɔyɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli koni amɛmu. Beni nu hiɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli be kakadaŋŋ tsɔ ni ejɛɛɛ mli. Enɛ baaha shishifãi lɛ agbɔjɔ ni ewo ŋmeii helai ni kɛ ŋmeii baa lɛ hewalɛ. Nɔ ni hewɔ ni dumɔwui ni aduɔ yɛ gɔŋji ni nɔ kwɔlɔ lɛ anɔ lɛ yeɔ ebuaa lɛ.

english: Why do my tomato plants drop their flowers without producing any fruits during the hot season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato tso lɛ fɔ̃ɔ ni ewooo yibii yɛ hulutsoo be mli lɛ?

english: When temperatures get too high and water is low, tomato plants get stressed and dump their flowers to preserve their own energy and survive the heat wave.
ga: Kɛji hulutsoo be lɛ mli wa tsɔ ni nu lɛ hu faaa lɛ, Tomato tsei lɛ baaná haomɔ ni amɛbaafɔ fɔfɔi amɛshwie shi koni amɛkɛbu amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhewalɛ he ni amɛhi shi yɛ hulutsoo be lɛ mli.

english: Leaf curling is usually caused by tiny sap-sucking insects like thrips or aphids hiding on the undersides of leaves, or a virus spread by whiteflies. Controlling these insects early prevents the leaf twisting.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, kooloi bibii ni nuɔ nu tamɔ thrips loo aphids ni kɛ amɛhe ewo baai lɛ ashishi lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ baai lɛ shwieɔ shi. loo virus ni whiteflies gbɛɔ eshwaa Nɛkɛ kooloi nɛɛ anɔkwɛmɔ mra Ebaaye ebua ni ebaatsi baai lɛ anaa koni amɛkatsake.

english: Why am I finding ragged holes in my maize leaves and small caterpillars inside the center of the plant?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ minaa bu ni etse ehe yɛ ŋmãa baai kɛ ŋmeii bibii amli lɛ? yɛ tso lɛ teŋgbɛ

english: This damage is caused by the Fall Armyworm, a pest that feeds on the soft growth center of maize. They hide deep inside the leaves to stay safe from heat and rain, so control sprays must be directed straight into the plant's funnel.
ga: Nɔ ni kɛ nɛkɛ fitemɔ nɛɛ baa ji Fall Armyworm, ni ji tsɛŋemɔ hela ko ni yeɔ ŋmãa bibii ni kwɛɔ ŋmãa nɔ lɛ. Amɛteɔ amɛhe amɛwoɔ baai lɛ amli shɔŋŋ koni amɛná shweshweeshwe kɛjɛ dɔlɛ kɛ nugbɔshiimɔ he. No hewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ akɛ tsofa ni akɛkudɔɔ nii lɛ awo tso lɛ mli tsɔnei lɛ amli tɛ̃ɛ.

english: Why are the leaves on my tomato plants curling upwards and getting white spots?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni yɔɔ mi tomato tsei lɛ anɔ lɛ ebɔle ehe ni eyɛ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ lɛ?

english: Leaf curling and spots are usually signs of fungal infections or attacks by tiny pests like whiteflies. Whiteflies suck the sap from the leaves, causing stress and spreading viruses, while fungi thrive when moisture sits on the leaves for too long.
ga: Baai kɛ ŋmɔtɔi ni ebɔle ehe lɛ Bei pii lɛ eji okadi ni tsɔɔ akɛ tsɛŋemɔ hela ko eba loo tsɛŋemɔ helai bibii tamɔ tsɛŋemɔ helai bibii ni yeɔ mɔ awui lɛ tutuamɔ. Whiteflies nuɔ nu ni jɛɔ baai lɛ amli lɛ. Enɛ kɛ haomɔ baa ni egbɛɔ helai ni gbeɔ mɔ lɛ eshwaa. Yɛ be mli ni ŋmeii lɛ daa kɛji ŋmɔtɔ babaoo yɛ baai lɛ anɔ lɛ.

english: What causes my ripe tomatoes to develop dark, rotten patches at the bottom of the fruit?
ga: Mɛni miiha mi tomato ni ekwɛ̃ lɛ miifee okadii ni tsuɔ ni efite yɛ aduawai lɛ ashishi lɛ?

english: This condition is called Blossom End Rot. It is caused by a lack of calcium in the plant as the fruit is growing, which often happens when watering is irregular or during dry spells.
ga: Shihilɛ nɛɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Blossom End Rot lɛ jɛɔ calcium ni bɛ tso lɛ mli be mli ni aduawai lɛ miida lɛ hewɔ. Bei pii lɛ, enɛ baa mli kɛ́ nu lɛ hoɔ yɛ gbɛ ni ejaaa nɔ loo yɛ be mli ni hulu enyɔ shi lɛ.

english: Why do small worms bore holes into my green tomato fruits before they even ripen?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmeii bibii miifo mi tomato eŋɔli lɛ mli dani amɛkwɛ̃ po lɛ?

english: These are tomato fruit borers, which are caterpillars that hatch from eggs laid on the flowers and leaves by moths. They crawl into the young fruit to feed, making the tomato rot and fall off early.
ga: Enɛɛmɛi ji ŋmeii ni shwieɔ tomato aduawai lɛ. Enɛɛmɛi ji ŋmeii ni jɛɔ ŋmeii ni ŋmeii kɛwoɔ fɔfɔii kɛ baai anɔ lɛ amli. Amɛkpãa kɛboteɔ aduawai bibii amli koni amɛye niyenii. Ehaa tomato fiteɔ ni egbeeɔ shi oya.

english: Why do my tomato plants drop their flowers before any fruit can grow?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi tomato tsei lɛ miiho fɔfɔi dani aduawai baanyɛ akwɛ̃ lɛ?

english: Tomato plants drop their flowers when they experience extreme heat stress, poor soil nutrients, or when the plant does not get enough consistent water during the flowering stage.
ga: Tomato tsei lɛ baashwie amɛfɔfɔi lɛ anɔ kɛji akɛ amɛkpe yɛ hulutsoo be mli. Niyenii ni bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli Aloo be mli ni tomato tsei lɛ náaa nu ni fa bɔ ni sa ni yaa nɔ daa yɛ be mli ni amɛwoɔ fɔfɔi lɛ.

english: Why are my tomatoes splitting open on the vine right before I pick them?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato lɛ miikwɛ̃ yɛ wain tso lɛ nɔ dani mifolɔ amɛ lɛ?

english: Tomatoes split when there is a sudden heavy rainfall or heavy watering after a dry period. The inside of the fruit grows faster than the skin can stretch, causing the skin to burst.
ga: Tomatoi baatswa kɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ trukaa loo nu ni mli wa yɛ nugbɔshiimɔ be sɛɛ. Yibii lɛ amli lɛ daa oya fe bɔ ni hewolo lɛ baanyɛ ashɛ he. Enɛ haa hewolo lɛ fãa.

english: Why do my tomatoes turn soft and rot so quickly after I harvest them to sell?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato lɛ feɔ blɛoo ni egboɔ oya beni mikpa amɛ koni mikɛhɔ̃ɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ?

english: Tomatoes rot quickly if they are harvested while wet with morning dew, packed too tightly in deep wooden crates, or left under the hot sun immediately after picking.
ga: Tomato lɛ fiteɔ oya kɛji akɛ akpa lɛ be mli ni leebi ŋmɔtɔ edɔ lɛ. Akɛwo tso adekai ni mli kwɔ amli tsɔ. Aloo shi yɛ hulu ni tsoɔ waa lɛ shishi kɛji ogbe naa amrɔ nɔŋŋ.

english: How do I know if my tomatoes need a chemical spray like a fungicide or if they just need more water?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male kɛji tsofa ko ni akɛshwieɔ mi-tomato lɛ nɔ tamɔ tsofa ni gbeɔ ŋmeii loo nu babaoo he miihia amɛ?

english: Lack of water causes the whole plant to wilt evenly during the day. Fungal diseases cause distinct spots, white powdery patches, or soft black rots on individual leaves and fruits.
ga: Nu ni bɛ lɛ haa tso muu lɛ fɛɛ shwieɔ shi pɛpɛɛpɛ. kɛ amɛhe feɔ ekome yɛ gbi lɛ mli Fungal hela kɛ ŋmɔtɔ ni mli tse baa. Powda yɛŋ ko yɛ jɛmɛ. aloo ŋmeii diji ni mli tse yɛ baai kɛ aduawai aŋkroaŋkroi anɔ.

english: How long should I wait after spraying crop medicine on my tomatoes before I can harvest them for the market?
ga: Beni awo ŋmɔshi nibii awo tomato nɔ lɛ, be enyiɛ esa akɛ mamɛ dani akpa amɛ kɛya jara nɔ?

english: Every crop medicine has a required waiting period called the Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI). It usually ranges from 3 to 14 days depending on the product, ensuring the chemical breaks down so the crop is safe for consumers.
ga: Tsofai ni akɛ tsofai tsuɔ nii yɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ yɛ be ni akɛmɛɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI), bei pii lɛ gbii 3 kɛyashi 14 ni damɔ nɔ ni akɛfee lɛ nɔ. Enɛ haa tsofai lɛ fiteɔ koni eha ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ afee nɔ ni yɔɔ shweshweeshwe kɛha mɛi ni yeɔ lɛ.

english: Why do my tomato plants grow very tall with many leaves, but produce very few tomatoes?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi tomato tso lɛ daa ni eyɛ baai babaoo lɛ? Shi ewo tomato fioo ko pɛ?

english: This happens when the soil has too much nitrogen fertilizer. Nitrogen encourages leafy green growth, but suppresses the plant from producing flowers and fruits.
ga: Enɛ baa mli kɛ́ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibii ni ji nitrogen lɛ fa babaoo. Nitrogen haa baa eŋɔli lɛ daa. Shi etsĩɔ tsei anaa koni amɛkawo fɔfɔi kɛ aduawai.

english: Why should I leave space between my tomato plants instead of planting them very close together?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mashi gbɛ yɛ tomato tsei lɛ ateŋ yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni madu amɛ ni amɛbɛŋkɛ amɛhe waa lɛ?

english: Spacing allows sunlight to reach all parts of the plant and lets air flow through. Good air movement dries wet leaves quickly, preventing fungal diseases from taking hold and spreading.
ga: Gbɛ ni kã amɛteŋ lɛ haa hulu la lɛ shɛɔ tso lɛ fãi fɛɛ ahe ni kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ hoɔ kɛtsɔɔ mli. Kɔɔyɔɔ kpakpa ni nyiɛɔ lɛ baaha baai ni efɔ lɛ agbi oya. Tsi tsɛŋemɔ helai ni jɛɔ tsɛŋemɔ helai amli lɛ anaa koni amɛkatswa amɛhe ni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã.

english: Young cocoa seedlings cannot withstand direct, harsh sunlight. Planting fast-growing shade crops like plantains alongside them provides necessary cover and keeps the soil moist during their early years.
ga: Cocoa dumɔwui nyɛɛɛ amɛŋmɛ hulu la ni naa wa lɛ gbɛ. Shade tsei ni kwɛ̃ɔ oya, tamɔ plantains, ni aduɔ yɛ masɛi Enɛ baaha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afee nɔ ni he hiaa ni eye ebua ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ yɛ shishijee afii lɛ amli.

english: Why do my cassava roots turn woody and hard if I leave them in the ground for too long?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava shishifãi lɛ feɔ tsei ni amɛhe wa kɛji akɛ ashi amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ be kakadaŋŋ tsɔ lɛ?

english: Cassava roots store starch as they grow, but if left unharvested long past maturity (usually 10 to 12 months), the plant converts that starch into fiber, making the tubers tough and difficult to cook.
ga: Cassava shishifãi toɔ starch be mli ni amɛdaraa lɛ. Shi kɛji akɛ ashi lɛ be kakadaŋŋ (bei pii lɛ nyɔji 10 kɛyashi 12) lɛ, tso lɛ baatsake nakai ŋmei lɛ ni etsɔ ŋmei. Enɛ haa ŋmeii lɛ feɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ ni ewaa akɛ aaaho.

english: Why do I need to stake my yam vines instead of letting them creep on the ground?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mikɛ mi-sweet potato wain tso lɛ woɔ tso nɔ moŋ fe ni mahã ekplekeshi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ?

english: Staking lifts the vine leaves into sunlight so the plant can make more food, while also keeping leaves off the hot, wet ground where fungal diseases easily spread.
ga: Staking haa wain tso lɛ baai lɛ shɛɔ hulu la nɔ bɔni afee ni tso lɛ anyɛ awo niyenii babaoo. Yɛ nakai beaŋ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ebuɔ baai lɛ ahe kɛjɛɔ hei ni mli edɔ kɛ hei ni ŋmɔtɔ yɔɔ ni tsɛŋemɔ helai ni haa mɔ he jɔ̃ɔ ehe lɛ gbɛɔ eshwaa oya lɛ ahe.

english: Why do my cassava roots rot in the soil during periods of heavy rain?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava shishifãi lɛ shwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Waterlogged soil fills air pockets around the roots, preventing them from breathing. Without oxygen, the cassava tubers suffocate and become vulnerable to soft-rot bacteria.
ga: Shikpɔŋ ni nu eyi mli obɔ lɛ eyiɔ kɔɔyɔɔ kotokui ni bɔleɔ shishifãi lɛ ahe lɛ amli, ni no haaa amɛmu. Kɛji oxygen bɛ lɛ, Cassava shishifãi lɛ baagbɔjɔ ni amɛbaanyɛ amɛye helai ni fiteɔ lɛ anɔ.

english: Yellowing lower leaves indicate a nitrogen deficiency in the soil. The maize plant pulls nitrogen from its older bottom leaves to feed new top leaves, causing the bottom ones to turn yellow.
ga: Baai ni yɔɔ shishigbɛ ni ji ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Abele tsei jieɔ nitrogen kɛjɛɔ baa momo ni yɔɔ shishigbɛ lɛ mli koni ekɛha ŋwɛi baa heei lɛ niyenii. Nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa ji akɛ, baai ni yɔɔ shishi lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ.

english: Controlled standing water suppresses weed growth and maintains continuous moisture and temperature for the rice roots, allowing the plant to take up nutrients steadily.
ga: Nu ni damɔ shi ni akudɔɔ lɛ tsiɔ jwɛi lɛ adalɛ naa ni ehaa hulutsoo kɛ latsaa hiɔ shi daa kɛhaa ŋmãa shishifãi. Eyeɔ ebuaa tsei ni amɛyaa nɔ amɛheɔ niyenii mli hewalɛ.

english: Tomato flowers drop when temperatures become too high or when there is sudden heat stress, as high heat prevents proper pollination and fruit formation.
ga: Tomato fɔfɔi lɛ baagbee shi kɛ́ hulutsoo be lɛ mli wa tsɔ loo kɛ́ hulutsoo be lɛ ba trukaa. Nɔ hewɔ ji akɛ, la ni tsoɔ waa lɛ tsiɔ pollination kɛ aduawai ni sa lɛ anaa.

english: Curled and twisted leaves on pepper plants are usually caused by tiny sap-sucking pests like thrips or aphids, or viruses carried by these insects.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, ŋmeii bibii ni nuɔ nu tamɔ thrips loo aphids ji nɔ ni kɛ baai ni ebɔle ehe ni ebɔle ehe lɛ baa. loo helai ni gbeɔ mɔ ni nɛkɛ kooloi nɛɛ kɛbaa lɛ

english: Why do extension officers recommend planting cowpeas or beans to improve my soil?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mɛi ni kwɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ woɔ ŋaa akɛ adu tsina loo ŋmeii koni shikpɔŋ lɛ aya hiɛ lɛ?

english: Legumes like cowpeas take nitrogen gas from the air and store it in their roots with the help of beneficial soil bacteria, naturally enriching the soil for crops planted after them.
ga: Legumes tamɔ cowpeas jieɔ nitrogen gas kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni amɛkɛtoɔ amɛshishifãi amli kɛtsɔ sũ mli helai ni he yɔɔ sɛɛnamɔ lɛ ayebuamɔ nɔ. Enɛ baaha shikpɔŋ lɛ afee nɔ ni hi jogbaŋŋ yɛ adebɔɔ naa koni tsei akwɛ̃ yɛ no sɛɛ.

english: Too many suckers compete with the main plantain stem for water and soil nutrients. Removing extra shoots leaves only 2 or 3 strong stems, resulting in larger and healthier plantain bunches.
ga: Tso lɛ yibii babaoo tsɔ kɛ plantain tso titri lɛ yeɔ akaŋ koni amɛná nu kɛ niyenii ni yɔɔ sũ lɛ mli. Kɛ́ ajie ŋmeii ni fa fe nine lɛ, ebaaha ŋmeii 2 loo 3 pɛ ahi shi ni yɔɔ hewalɛ, ni no baaha ŋmeii ni dara ni yɔɔ hewalɛ aba.

english: Do not plant immediately after the very first rain because the soil underneath is still hot and dry. Wait until you get two or three heavy rains so the soil retains enough deep moisture to help the seeds germinate and grow strong roots.
ga: Kaadu nii amrɔ nɔŋŋ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nugbɔ lɛ sɛɛ ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ shishi lɛ mli edɔ lolo ni egbi. Mɛɛ ni nugbɔ nɛ waa shii enyɔ loo etɛ aba koni eha shikpɔŋ lɛ anyɛ ahiɛ ŋmɔtɔ ni mli kwɔ bɔ ni sa ni eye ebua dumɔwui lɛ ni amɛkwɛ̃ ni amɛná shishifãi ni wa.

english: Is it better to plant my seeds in straight lines or scatter them across the field?
ga: Ani ehi akɛ aaadu dumɔwui lɛ yɛ gbɛ ni ja nɔ loo agbɛ amɛ ashwã ŋmɔ lɛ mli?

english: Planting in straight lines gives every crop enough space to receive sunlight, water, and soil nutrients. It also makes weeding, applying fertilizer, and harvesting much easier compared to scattering seeds.
ga: Dumɔ ni aduɔ yɛ gbɛ ni ja nɔ lɛ haa tsei fɛɛ náa gbɛ ni fa bɔ ni sa koni amɛná hulu la, nu kɛ niyenii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Ehaa jwɛi shwiemɔ, ŋmɔshi nibii ni akɛwoɔ mli, kɛ ŋmaakpamɔ hu feɔ mlɛo kwraa fe dumɔwui ni agbɛɔ ashwãa.

english: Cassava naturally drops its leaves during dry periods to conserve water and survive the heat. As long as the stems remain green inside, the roots underground are safe, and fresh leaves will sprout once the rains return.
ga: Cassava shwieɔ ebaa lɛ shi yɛ adebɔɔ naa yɛ hulutsoo be mli koni ekɛhiɛ nu mli ni enyɛ edamɔ dɔlɛ naa. Shii abɔ ni tso lɛ shishifãi lɛ baahi shi yɛ mli lɛ Shikpɔŋ shishi shishifãi lɛ yɛ shweshweeshwe. Ni baai heei baakwɛ̃ kɛji nugbɔ lɛ ku esɛɛ eba.

english: Tomato flowers often drop off due to extreme afternoon heat, lack of water, or too much nitrogen fertilizer. Giving your plants consistent water and shade during peak heat helps the flowers set fruit successfully.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, tomato fɔfɔii lɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ shwane mli latsaa ni naa wa, nu ni bɛ, loo nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii babaoo hewɔ. Nu kɛ hulutsoo ni akɛhaa tsei yɛ be mli ni hulutsoo be lɛ mli wa waa lɛ yeɔ ebuaa fɔfɔi kɛ aduawai lɛ ni amɛwoɔ omanye.

english: Why do crops on one part of my land grow tall and green while those on another part stay stunted?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmɔshi nibii ni yɔɔ mishikpɔŋ lɛ fã kome nɔ lɛ shwereɔ ni efeɔ ŋmɔji yɛ be mli ni ŋmɔshi nibii ni yɔɔ fa kroko lɛ nɔ lɛ shwereɔ lɛ?

english: Soil quality varies across a farm. Low-lying areas or places where leaves rot naturally hold more nutrients and moisture, while rocky, sloped, or heavily farmed spots lack the food plants need to grow big.
ga: Esoro bɔ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ yɔɔ ha yɛ ŋmɔ fɛɛ ŋmɔ mli. Hei ni yɔɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ loo hei ni baai lɛ miifite yɛ lɛ haa niyenii kɛ ŋmɔtɔ hiɔ shi yɛ adebɔɔ naa. Yɛ be mli ni hei ni tɛi yɔɔ, ŋshɔkpɔi ni nɔ kwɔlɔ loo ŋmɔji ni tsii Ebɛ niyenii ni he hiaa tsei koni amɛdara lɛ.

english: Planting the same crop continuously drains specific nutrients from the soil and allows crop-specific pests to multiply. Rotating maize with legumes like cowpeas or groundnuts restores soil fertility naturally and breaks pest cycles.
ga: Nibii kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ ni aduɔ daa lɛ haa niyenii pɔtɛɛ komɛi jeɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. ni ehaa tsei pɔtɛɛ komɛi amli tsɛŋemɔ helai babaoo. Abɛi ni akɛ ŋmeii tamɔ tsina loo ŋmeii tsakeɔ lɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ feɔ fɛo ekoŋŋ ni efiteɔ tsɛŋemɔ helai ni yeɔ mɔ awui lɛ.

english: Why do weeds sprout back so quickly right after I clear and weed my farm?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ jwɛi lɛ kwɛ̃ɔ ekoŋŋ oya nɛkɛ beni mijie miŋmɔ lɛ mli ni mijie jwɛi lɛ?

english: Weed seeds can lie dormant underground for years. When you turn the soil or clear the weeds, you bring hidden seeds to the surface where sunlight and rain cause them to sprout immediately.
ga: Jwɛi dumɔwui baanyɛ awɔ. shikpɔŋ shishi afii babaoo Kɛ́ otsɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ loo ojie jwɛi lɛ Ehe baahia ni okɛ dumɔwui ni yɔɔ teemɔŋ lɛ aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni hulu la kɛ nugbɔ baaha amɛkwɛ̃ amrɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ.

english: These are likely fall armyworms, which target the fresh growing center of young corn. Spraying approved treatments early in the morning or late in the evening when the worms are active will protect your crop.
ga: Ekolɛ enɛɛmɛi ji shikpɔŋ nɔ ŋmeii ni kwɛɔ hei ni ŋmãa bibii lɛ daraa yɛ lɛ. Kɛ́ okɛ tsofa ko ni akpɛlɛ nɔ lɛ shwie nɔ leebi loo gbɛkɛ be mli ni tsɛŋemɔ hela lɛ miitsu nii lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni ebu onibii ahe.

english: How long will it take after I plant new hybrid cocoa trees before I can harvest my first pods?
ga: Be enyiɛ sɛɛ dani manyɛ makpa klɛŋklɛŋ ŋmeii lɛ?

english: Hybrid cocoa varieties usually start bearing fruit within 2 to 3 years if properly shaded and weeded, compared to traditional varieties which can take up to 5 years.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, kookoo henɔi ni akɛfee ekome lɛ jeɔ yibiiwoo shishi yɛ afii 2 kɛyashi 3 mli kɛji akɛ ahã amɛ hulutsoo jogbaŋŋ ni ajie jwɛi kɛjɛ amɛmli. Akɛ enɛ toɔ blema kookoo henɔi ni baanyɛ ahé afii 5 lɛ ahe.

english: How can I keep insects from eating my harvested maize while it is stored in my room?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ matsi kooloi bibii anaa koni amɛkaye ŋmãa ni mikpaa lɛ be mli ni akɛto mitsu lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Ensure the maize is thoroughly dried until the kernels are hard before storage. Storing the grain in sealed hermetic bags or treating it with approved storage dust stops insects from feeding on your harvest.
ga: Kwɛmɔ ni ŋmãa lɛ agbi kwraa kɛyashi ŋmãa lɛ baafee shiŋŋ dani okɛto. Dumɔwui ni akɛtoɔ kotokui ni atsĩ naa mli loo ni akɛtoɔ he ko ni sũ nyɛŋ abote mli yɛ he ko ni akpɛlɛ nɔ akɛ akɛto. Enɛ baaye abua ni kooloi akaye onibii.

english: If I mix extra nutrients into my irrigation water, will it make my tomato plants grow twice as fast?
ga: Kɛ mikɛ niyenii mli nibii krokomɛi futu nu ni akɛshwieɔ nu lɛ mli lɛ Ani ebaaha mi-tomato tsei lɛ adara oya fe tsutsu lɛ shii enyɔ?

english: No, plants can only absorb a specific amount of nutrients at a time. Adding too much to their water can burn their roots and stunt their growth instead of helping them.
ga: Dabi, tsei baanyɛ aŋɔ niyenii mli hewalɛ fioo ko pɛ yɛ be kome mli. Kɛ́ akɛ nu babaoo fata he lɛ, ebaanyɛ eshã eshishifãi lɛ ni eha ekwɛɛɛ jogbaŋŋ. Yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni eeeye ebua amɛ lɛ

english: Why do my pepper leaves dry out and yellow even after I gave them a high dose of liquid plant food?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper baai lɛ egbi ni eyɛ ŋmɔŋ eyɛ mli akɛ mikɛ tso niyenii ni mli ewo nu babaoo eha amɛ moŋ?

english: Giving crops more fertilizer than they can handle causes fertilizer burn. Excess chemicals overload the soil and draw water away from the plant roots, causing the leaves to wither.
ga: Kɛ́ aha ŋmɔshi nibii babaoo fe bɔ ni amɛbaanyɛ amɛye lɛ, ebaaha ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ ashã. Tsofai ni fa fe nine lɛ haa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hoɔ babaoo ni egbalaa nu kɛjɛɔ tsei lɛ ashishifãi amli. ha baai lɛ agbo

english: Is it safe to put growth chemicals directly into the water I use for watering my vegetable garden?
ga: Ani eyɛ shweshweeshwe akɛ mikɛ tsofai ni haa mɔ daa lɛ baafata nu ni mikɛtsuɔ nii kɛwoɔ mi-aduawai abɔɔ lɛ mli nu lɛ he tɛ̃ɛ?

english: It is only safe if you measure the exact recommended dose. If you put too much in the water, the strong solution will overload the plant roots, making them unable to absorb clean water.
ga: Eyɛ shweshweeshwe pɛ kɛji osusu tsofa ni akɛhaa lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Kɛ okɛ nu babaoo fata he lɛ Nu ni mli ewo muji lɛ baaye tso lɛ shishifãi lɛ anɔ. ni no haa enyɛɛɛ ejie nu ni mli tse

english: Can I double the strength of a water-soluble crop booster to save time when feeding my yam plants?
ga: Ani manyɛ mafee tso ni shwieɔ nu mli lɛ hewalɛ shii enyɔ koni mikɛ be akafite beni mikɛ mi-sweet potato tsei lɛ yeɔ nii lɛ?

english: Doubling the strength creates a high chemical concentration that can kill your yam vines. Plants absorb nutrients best in light, consistent doses rather than heavy, concentrated amounts.
ga: Hewalɛ ni ji enyɔ lɛ haa tsofai ni fa babaoo ni baanyɛ agbe o-sweet potato wain tso lɛ baa. Tsei ŋmɛɔ niyenii mli hewalɛ jogbaŋŋ yɛ la mli, kɛji amɛyi fa po. Yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni oooŋɔ nibii ni fa babaoo lɛ

english: Can spraying vitamin mixtures on my cassava protect them from catching cassava mosaic disease?
ga: Ani vitamin ni akɛfutuɔ nii ni akɛshwieɔ ŋmei nɔ lɛ baanyɛ atsĩ ŋmei mosaic hela lɛ naa?

english: Vitamins do not protect plants from viral or fungal diseases. To stop diseases, you need disease-resistant crop varieties or specific control measures like fungicides and pest control, not nutrient sprays.
ga: Vitamins ebuuu tsei ahe kɛjɛɛɛ helai ni baa mɔ mli loo tsɛŋemɔ helai ahe. Bɔni afee ni akpa hela lɛ Ohe miihia tsei srɔtoi ni nyɛɔ helai pɔtɛɛ komɛi loo gbɛi ni atsɔɔ nɔ akudɔɔ hela lɛ, tamɔ tsofai ni gbeɔ ŋmeii kɛ tsofai ni gbeɔ ŋmeii. Jeee niyenii mli hewalɛ ni akɛshwieɔ nɔ lɛ ni.

english: Will feeding my pepper plants extra plant booster make them immune to insect leaf curl attacks?
ga: Ani kɛ́ mikɛ tsofa krɛdɛɛ ko ni haa mɔ tsui nyɔɔ emli lɛ ha mi-pepper tsei lɛ, ebaaha amɛnyɛŋ amɛye leaf curl bug lɛ nɔ?

english: Plant food helps healthy plants grow leaves, but it acts as food, not medicine. It cannot protect or cure pepper plants from insect-borne viruses like leaf curl.
ga: Tse niyenii yeɔ ebuaa tsei ni amɛdaraa waa ni amɛdaraa kɛtsɔɔ baai anɔ. Shi etsuɔ ​​nii akɛ niyenii, shi jeee tsofa. Enyɛŋ ebu pepper tsei ahe loo etsa amɛ kɛjɛ helai ni kooloi kɛbaa tamɔ baai ni shwieɔ shi lɛ ahe.

english: If a plant disease breaks out on neighbor farms, should I start pouring crop boosters into my watering system to prevent it?
ga: Kɛji tso hela ko ba akutsoŋnyo ko ŋmɔ mli Ani esa akɛ mabɔi tsei ahe nibii ni haa mɔ tsui nyɔɔ emli lɛ shwiemɔ mi nu ni mikɛhaa lɛ mli koni mikɛbu mihe?

english: Crop boosters only feed the plant; they do not shield crops from infections during an outbreak. You should instead use proper crop protection products, remove infected plants, or use disease-resistant seeds.
ga: Nibii ni kanyaa tsei lɛ haa tsei niyenii pɛ. Amɛbuuu ŋmɔshi nibii ahe kɛjɛɛɛ helai ahe yɛ be mli ni helai lɛ baa lɛ. Esa akɛ okɛ nibii ni sa ni buɔ tsei ahe lɛ atsu nii. Jiemɔ tsei ni hela lɛ emɔmɔ amɛ lɛ. Aloo okɛ dumɔwui ni helai nyɛɔ amɛyeɔ lɛ atsu nii moŋ.

english: What happens if I give my maize more liquid booster than the bottle label says?
ga: Mɛni baa kɛji akɛ miha ŋmãa lɛ nu ni yeɔ ebuaa lɛ babaoo fe bɔ ni aŋma yɛ tɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ?

english: Using more than recommended wastes your money and damages the plant. Excess nutrients cannot be taken up by the plant and can lock up other essential minerals in the soil, preventing proper growth.
ga: Kɛ́ okɛ nɔ ni fe bɔ ni atsɔɔ akɛ okɛtsu nii lɛ tsu nii lɛ, ebaaha ofite shika ni ebaafite otso lɛ. Tsei nyɛɛɛ aŋɔ niyenii mli hewalɛ ni fa fe nine lɛ, ni amɛbaanyɛ amɛhiɛ nibii krokomɛi ni he hiaa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli, ni no haaa amɛdara jogbaŋŋ.

english: How can I tell if a new chemical booster sold at the agrochemical shop actually works for cocoa?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male kɛji akɛ tsofa hee ko ni akɛwoɔ mli ni ahɔ̃ɔ yɛ agrochemical shwapoi amli lɛ kɛ kookoo tsuɔ nii diɛŋtsɛ?

english: Always check for approval from agricultural authorities like the Ministry of Food and Agriculture (MoFA) or EPA. If a product promises miracles without official approval, it often lacks proven benefits.
ga: Kwɛmɔ be fɛɛ be akɛ okwaayeli nitsumɔhei tamɔ Ministry of Food and Agriculture (MoFA) loo EPA lɛ ekpɛlɛ nɔ kɛji akɛ nɔ ko wo shi akɛ ebaatsu naakpɛɛ nii ni maŋ onukpai lɛ ekpɛlɛɛɛ nɔ. Bei pii lɛ, amɛbɛ sɛɛnamɔi ni ana he odaseyeli.

english: Does pouring liquid booster directly on plant leaves work better than putting fertilizer in the soil?
ga: Ani booster solution ni akɛshwieɔ tso lɛ baai anɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ tsuɔ nii jogbaŋŋ fe ŋmɔshi nibii ni akɛwoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Leaves can only absorb small amounts of liquid nutrients through their pores. Soil fertilizers are usually better because plant roots are designed to absorb large amounts of food and water.
ga: Baai lɛ baanyɛ aŋɔ nu mli niyenii fioo ko pɛ kɛtsɔ amɛ ŋmeii lɛ amli. Bei pii lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ŋmɔshi nibii ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ hi jogbaŋŋ ejaakɛ afee tsei shishifãi lɛ koni amɛnyɛ amɛŋɔ niyenii kɛ nu babaoo.

english: Why is it important to test or check my soil before planting a new crop?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ehe hiaa ni maka mishikpɔŋ lɛ makwɛ loo makwɛ mli jogbaŋŋ dani madu tsei heei lɛ?

english: Soil testing reveals what nutrients your soil already contains and what it lacks, helping you apply the exact type and amount of fertilizer your crop needs for strong growth.
ga: Shikpɔŋ nɔ kaa tsɔɔ niyenii mli nibii ni yɔɔ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ nɔ ni bɛ mli. Ehaa okɛ ŋmɔshi nibii pɔtɛɛ ni he hiaa tsei lɛ koni amɛdara waa lɛ awo mli.

english: Yellow leaves usually show that the maize lacks nitrogen, an essential nutrient needed for making food and developing strong green leaves. Applying nitrogen fertilizer like urea helps restore health.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ ŋmãa mli. ni ji niyenii ni he hiaa waa kɛha niyenii homɔ kɛ baai eŋɔli ni mli wa ni anáa Nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii tamɔ urea ni akɛtsuɔ nii lɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa mɔ náa hewalɛ ekoŋŋ.

english: Why do my maize crops grow tall and thin with tiny cobs when I plant them close together?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-abele lɛ daa ni eyɛ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ ni eyɛ ŋmeii bibii lɛ? Be ni adu yɛ he ko ni bɛŋkɛ he?

english: When crops are planted too close, they compete for sunlight, soil nutrients, and water. Proper spacing gives each plant enough space and food to grow thick stalks and large cobs.
ga: Kɛji adu tsei ni bɛŋkɛ tsɔ Tsei lɛ baatswa hulu la he akaŋ. Shikpɔŋ nɔ niyenii kɛ nu Gbɛ ni sa ni akɛtoɔ tso fɛɛ tso he lɛ haa tso fɛɛ tso naa he kɛ niyenii ni fa bɔ ni sa ni ekɛbaakwɛ̃ ŋmeii ni mli tse kɛ ŋmeii wuji.

english: Why are caterpillars eating the inner leaves of my young maize plants during the early stages?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmeii lɛ yeɔ mi-baby corn tsei lɛ amli baai lɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbɛ nɔ lɛ?

english: These are often Fall Armyworms that target the tender, central funnel of young maize plants because the leaves are soft to chew and provide shelter while feeding.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, enɛɛmɛi ji Fall Armyworms ni kwɛɔ ŋmãa tsei bibii lɛ ateŋgbɛ gbɛi ni yɔɔ mlɛo lɛ anɔ ejaakɛ baai bibii lɛ shwieɔ ni amɛhaa he ko ni amɛhiɔ be mli ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ.

english: Why do my young cocoa seedlings wither and die when planted in full sunlight?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cacao tsei bibii lɛ shwieɔ shi ni amɛgboiɔ kɛ́ adu amɛ yɛ hulutsoo be mli lɛ?

english: Young cocoa plants have tender leaves that burn easily under intense heat. Planting temporary shade crops like plantains shields young cocoa trees and preserves soil moisture.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii lɛ yɛ baai bibii ni shãa oya yɛ la ni naa wa waa shishi. Kɛ́ adu tsei ni haa hulu tsoɔ be kukuoo ko, tamɔ plantains lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni ebu kookoo tsei bibii ahe, ni ebaaha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ŋmɔtɔ akafee nɔ ko.

english: Why are my cocoa trees dropping their flowers before forming pods?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cacao tsei lɛ shwieɔ shi dani amɛkwɛ̃ɔ lɛ?

english: Trees drop flowers when stressed by dry weather, insect attacks, or poor soil nutrients, as the plant conserves energy to survive rather than spending it on growing fruit.
ga: Tsei shwieɔ fɔfɔi kɛji kɔɔyɔŋ ni mli egbi, koolooi tutuamɔ, loo shikpɔŋ mli niyenii ni ehiii lɛ hao amɛ. Nɔ hewɔ ji akɛ, tsei kɛ hewalɛ toɔ koni amɛhi shi moŋ fe ni amɛaafite yɛ aduawai ni amɛduɔ lɛ he.

english: Why do my yam plants produce heavy leafy vines but very small tubers under the ground?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-sweet potato tso lɛ woɔ wain tsei ni baai lɛ mli tse lɛ? Shi yitso bibioo ko kwraa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi?

english: Excessive nitrogen causes yam plants to put all their energy into growing leaves above ground rather than tubers below. Balanced fertilizers rich in potassium help shift energy down into the tubers.
ga: Nitrogen ni fa fe nine lɛ haa sweet potato tso lɛ kɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ woɔ baai ni miida yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ amli moŋ fe shikpɔŋ shishi ŋmeii. Nibii ni akɛwoɔ mli ni ja ni potassium babaoo yɔɔ mli lɛ baaye abua ni ekɛ hewalɛ aba shi kɛya bulb lɛ nɔ.

english: Dropping leaves is cassava's natural way of reducing water loss during dry spells. Once the rains return, the plant uses energy stored in its roots to sprout fresh green leaves.
ga: Baai lɛ ni ashɛrɛɔ ashwieɔ lɛ ji ŋmei adebɔɔ mli gbɛ ni etsɔɔ nɔ ehaa nu ni fiteɔ yɛ nugbɔshiimɔ be lɛ mli lɛ baa shi. Kɛ nugbɔ lɛ ku esɛɛ eba lɛ Tsei kɛ hewalɛ ni ato yɛ amɛshishifãi lɛ amli lɛ tsuɔ nii koni amɛkwɛ baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ.

english: This issue is called blossom-end rot, caused by uneven watering during fruit growth, which prevents the plant from taking up enough calcium from the soil.
ga: Atsɛɔ naagba nɛɛ akɛ fɔmɔ naagbee fitemɔ. Nɔ ni kɛ enɛ baa ji nu ni akɛwoɔ mli be fɛɛ be yɛ be mli ni aduawai lɛ miida lɛ. Enɛ haa tsei lɛ náaa calcium ni fa bɔ ni sa kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli.

english: Why do weeds grow faster than my planted crops after the first rainfall?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ jwɛi lɛ daa oya fe tsei ni midu yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nugbɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ?

english: Weeds are wild plants adapted to local soil conditions and remain dormant waiting for rain, allowing them to absorb moisture and nutrients much faster than cultivated seeds.
ga: Jwɛi ji koo mli tsei ni etsɔ amɛhe amɛwo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shihilɛi amli ni amɛyaa wɔɔ ni amɛmɛɔ nugbɔ, ni no haa amɛheɔ nu kɛ niyenii mli hewalɛ oya fe dumɔwui ni adu lɛ.

english: Why do my maize seeds rot in the soil if I plant right after the very first rain?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-abele dumɔwui lɛ fiteɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli kɛji midu amɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nugbɔ lɛ sɛɛ nɔŋŋ?

english: The first rain often heats up dry soil and is usually followed by a sunspell. Planting immediately traps seeds in hot, humid soil, causing them to rot before steady rain begins.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, klɛŋklɛŋ nugbɔ lɛ haa shikpɔŋ ni egbi lɛ mli dɔɔ. ni bei pii lɛ, hulutsoo be mli ŋmɔlɔ nyiɛɔ sɛɛ. Dumɔwui lɛ amɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni mli edɔ kɛ ŋmɔtɔ mli amrɔ nɔŋŋ. Nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa ji akɛ, dumɔwui lɛ fiteɔ dani nugbɔ nɛɔ waa.

english: If previous crops grew slowly, had pale yellow leaves, or produced small yields, the soil is likely low on nutrients and will benefit from compost, manure, or fertilizer.
ga: Kɛji tso ni tsɔ hiɛ lɛ da blɛoo Eyɛ baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ. loo ewoɔ yibii fioo Etamɔ nɔ ni niyenii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ hu faaa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ebaaná ŋmɔshi nibii, ŋmɔshi nibii, loo ŋmɔshi nibii ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ he sɛɛ.

english: Is it good for my soil if I plant cowpeas or beans together with my maize?
ga: Ani ehi kɛha shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛji mikɛ ŋmãa du tsina ŋmãa loo ŋmãa?

english: Yes, beans and cowpeas pull nitrogen out of the air and put it back into the soil, acting like natural fertilizer that helps your maize grow stronger.
ga: Hɛɛ, ŋmeii kɛ tsina ŋmeii jieɔ nitrogen kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni amɛkɛwoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli ekoŋŋ. Etsuɔ nii tamɔ adebɔɔ mli ŋmɔshi nibii ni yeɔ ebuaa o-corn lɛ ni edara waa.

english: What is eating small holes into my maize leaves and leaving dirt inside the stem?
ga: Mɛni ji bu bibioo lɛ yeli? Botemɔ mi ŋmãa baai lɛ amli ni oshi muji yɛ ŋmeii lɛ amli?

english: This damage is typically caused by Fall Armyworm caterpillars feeding inside the central leaves. Applying neem leaf extract or recommended insecticides directly into the plant whorl can control them.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, Fall Armyworm ŋmeii ni yeɔ baai ni yɔɔ teŋgbɛ lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ nɛkɛ fitemɔ nɛɛ baa. Abaanyɛ akudɔ neem tso lɛ mli nu loo tsofa ni gbeɔ kooloi ni akɛwoɔ ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ amli tɛ̃ɛ lɛ ni akɛtsuɔ nii lɛ.

english: Why are the bottom parts of my tomatoes turning black and soft before they get ripe?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ tomato shishi feɔ ediŋŋ ni efeɔ blɛoo dani eshɛɔ lɛ?

english: This is called blossom-end rot and happens when tomato plants do not get enough calcium or steady water while fruits are growing. Keeping soil evenly moist helps stop it.
ga: Atsɛɔ enɛ akɛ blossom end rot ni ebaa kɛji akɛ tomato tsei lɛ enine shɛɛɛ calcium ni fa bɔ ni sa loo nu ni yaa nɔ daa nɔ be mli ni aduawai lɛ miida lɛ. Kɛ́ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛ̃i pɛpɛɛpɛ lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni ekpa ni egbi.

english: Why are my pepper flowers dropping off without turning into peppers?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper fɔfɔi lɛ shwieɔ shi ni etsɔɔɔ pepper lɛ?

english: Pepper plants drop flowers when soil becomes too dry, during extremely hot weather, or when insects that help pollinate the flowers are killed off by strong chemicals.
ga: Pepper tsei lɛ shwieɔ amɛfɔfɔi lɛ kɛji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ egbi tsɔ. Yɛ be mli ni kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli edɔ waa Aloo be mli ni akɛ tsofai ni mli wa jieɔ kooloi bibii ni yeɔ ebuaa ni fɔfɔii lɛ shwieɔ shi lɛ.

english: Why are my young cocoa leaves turning yellow and curling up during the dry Harmattan season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-kookoo baai bibii lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ ni amɛfeɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ yɛ harmattan be ni hulu lɛ enyɔ shi lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Cocoa plants struggle under intense direct sunlight and dry winds. Leaves curl and yellow to protect the plant from losing too much water, which is why shade trees are essential.
ga: Cocoa tsei lɛ bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ waa yɛ hulu la ni naa wa kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli egbi ni tswaa tɛ̃ɛ lɛ shishi. Baai lɛ shwieɔ amɛhe ni amɛfeɔ ŋmɔŋ koni amɛkɛbu tso lɛ he kɛjɛ nu ni fiteɔ fe nine lɛ he. Nɔ ni haa tsei ni haa hulutsoo baa lɛ he hiaa waa lɛ.

english: Why are my cassava plants growing very tall with many leaves but making tiny tubers underground?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava lɛ daa ni eyɛ baai babaoo shi eyɛ ŋmeii bibii yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi lɛ?

english: Excess nitrogen in the soil makes cassava put all its energy into leaf growth instead of roots. Avoiding over-fertilizing with high-nitrogen fertilizers helps tubers swell.
ga: Nitrogen ni fa fe nine ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ haa ŋmei kɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ woɔ baai ni miida lɛ amli moŋ fe shishifãi. Nitrogen ni fa babaoo ni akɛwoɔ mli fe nine lɛ ni oootsi ohe kɛjɛ he lɛ baaye abua ni bulb lɛ afuu.

english: Why should I cut off some of the small shoots coming up around my plantain stand?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mafolɔ tsei bibii lɛ? ni kwɛ̃ɔ kɛbɔleɔ Mi plantains lɛ eje kpo.

english: Too many young shoots steal water and nutrients from the main plant. Keeping only two or three healthy shoots allows the main plantain tree to fruit faster and produce larger bunches.
ga: Tso lɛ mli tsei bibii babaoo juɔ nu kɛ niyenii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ kɛjɛɔ tso titri lɛ mli. Kɛ́ okɛ tsei enyɔ loo etɛ pɛ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ to lɛ, ebaaye ebua dumɔwui titrii lɛ ni amɛwo yibii oya ni amɛfee ŋmeii wuji.

english: Does lifting my yam vines onto sticks really help them make bigger yams?
ga: Ani mi-sweet potato wain tso lɛ ni miwoɔ yɛ nine nɔ lɛ yeɔ ebuaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ni edara?

english: Yes, lifting yam vines on stakes exposes more leaves to sunlight, which allows the plant to produce more energy and store it underground as larger yam tubers.
ga: Hɛɛ, kɛ́ awó sweet potato wain tso lɛ nɔ yɛ tso nɔ lɛ, ebaaha hulu la babaoo ashɛ etso lɛ he. Enɛ haa tsei lɛ feɔ hewalɛ babaoo. ni akɛtoɔ shikpɔŋ shishi akɛ yam ŋmeii wuji

english: How do I know if my soil is healthy enough to give me a good harvest this season?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male akɛ mishikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ hewalɛ bɔ ni sa ni baanyɛ awo ŋmɔshi nibii kpakpai yɛ be nɛɛ mli?

english: Healthy soil is dark, crumbly, holds water well, and is full of earthworms. If your soil feels hard like brick or looks pale, it lacks organic matter, which you can fix by adding decomposed animal manure or green leaves before planting.
ga: Shikpɔŋ kpakpa lɛ yɛ ediŋŋ, eyɛ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ, ehiɛɔ nu jogbaŋŋ, ni shikpɔŋ nɔ ŋmeii eyi mli obɔ. Kɛji oshikpɔŋ lɛ mli wa tamɔ brikii loo etamɔ nɔ ni eyɛ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ Tsɔɔmɔ akɛ nibii ni wala yɔɔ mli lɛ faaa. Abaanyɛ asaa enɛ kɛtsɔ kooloo ŋmei ni egbo loo baai eŋɔli ni akɛbaafata he dani adu lɛ nɔ.

english: Why do my maize leaves turn yellow even when I clear and weed the farm regularly?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmãa baai lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ lɛ? Namɛi saa ŋmɔ lɛ mli ni amɛjieɔ jwɛi lɛ daa?

english: Yellow leaves on maize usually mean the crop is lacking nitrogen, a key nutrient for green growth. Clearing weeds helps, but if the soil is exhausted, adding compost or fertilizer feeds the plant so it can turn dark green and grow strong.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋmãa nɔ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ tso lɛ mli. ni ji niyenii ni he hiaa waa kɛha ŋmɔshi nibii ni yaa hiɛ lɛ Jwɛi ni ajieɔ lɛ yeɔ ebuaa, shi kɛji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ egbɔ lɛ, okɛ ŋmɔshi nibii loo ŋmɔshi nibii afata he koni tso lɛ aya nɔ etsɔ ŋmɔji ni mli edɔ ni eda waa.

english: What makes some cassava plants grow huge tubers while others in the same field remain very thin?
ga: Mɛni haa ŋmeii tsei komɛi feɔ ŋmeii wuji? yɛ be mli ni tsei krokomɛi Yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ lɛ, ŋmeii ni mli tseee waa yɛ lolo.

english: Cassava tubers grow large when plants have loose, uncompacted soil, proper spacing, and enough sunshine. If soil is too hard or plants are crowded together, the roots cannot expand to store food.
ga: Cassava shishifãi lɛ baakwɛ̃ babaoo kɛji tsei lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni mli tse, ni jeee shikpɔŋ ni mli edɔ, ni amɛyɛ he ni sa. ni hulu la ni fa bɔ ni sa Kɛji shikpɔŋ lɛ mli wa tsɔ loo tsei lɛ ebɔle amɛhe Shishifãi lɛ nyɛŋ alɛɛ mli ni amɛkɛ niyenii ato.

english: Why do my tomato plants grow tall and thin without producing many leaves or fruits?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi tomato tsei lɛ miida ni amɛmiiya shɔŋŋ ni amɛbɛ baai loo aduawai babaoo lɛ?

english: When tomato plants grow long and thin, they are stretching to find sunshine because they are shaded by nearby trees or planted too close together. Tomatoes need full sunlight all day to grow thick stems and support fruit.
ga: Kɛ tomato tso lɛ da ni efee mlɛo Amɛbaakpã amɛhe koni amɛna hulu la ejaakɛ tsei ni bɛŋkɛ amɛ lɛ ewo amɛhe shade loo amɛdu amɛ ni amɛbɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ. Hulu ni fa babaoo he miihia tomatoi yɛ gbi muu lɛ fɛɛ mli koni ekwɛ̃ ni ekwɛ̃ ni eye ebua aduawai lɛ.

english: Pepper plants drop flowers when they experience stress from extreme sun, dry soil, or lack of nutrients like calcium. Keeping soil moist with mulch and feeding the plants helps flowers stay on and form fruits.
ga: Pepper tsei lɛ baashwie amɛfɔfɔi lɛ anɔ kɛji hulu la ni tsoɔ waa, shikpɔŋ ni egbi, loo niyenii mli hewalɛ tamɔ calcium ni bɛ lɛ hao amɛ. Kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔtɔ ha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni akɛha tso lɛ niyenii lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa fɔfɔi lɛ ni amɛhiɔ shi ni amɛwoɔ yibii.

english: Why does planting my crop seeds closer together give me less yield instead of more?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ dumɔwui ni aduɔ yɛ he kome lɛ woɔ yibii fioo moŋ fe babaoo lɛ?

english: When seeds are planted too close together, the crops compete against each other for water, soil food, and sunlight. Correct spacing gives each plant enough space to spread roots and produce bigger fruits or grains.
ga: Kɛ dumɔwui lɛ bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ lɛ, Nibii ni aduɔ lɛ kɛ amɛhe woɔ nu, shikpɔŋ mli niyenii, kɛ hulu la he akaŋ, ni gbɛ ni sa ni akɛtoɔ he lɛ haa tso fɛɛ tso naa gbɛ ni fa bɔ ni sa ni ekɛgbɛɔ eshishifãi lɛ eshwaa ni ewoɔ yibii loo dumɔwui wuji.

english: Why do weeds grow faster and stronger than the crops I actually planted?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ jwɛi lɛ daa oya ni amɛhe wa fe tsei ni miduɔ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ?

english: Weeds are wild plants adapted to survive on very low nutrients and water. Crops need extra care, clear ground, and early weeding so weeds do not steal the food and water meant for your crops.
ga: Jwɛi ji koo mli tsei ni etsake amɛhe koni amɛhi shi yɛ niyenii kɛ nu ni faaa kwraa mli. Tso lɛ he miihia kwɛmɔ krɛdɛɛ, he ko ni agbele kɛ jwɛi ni ajieɔ mra. Bɔni afee ni jwɛi lɛ akaju niyenii kɛ nu ni ato he gbɛjianɔ kɛha onibii lɛ.

english: It is best to water early in the morning. Watering in the hot afternoon causes water to evaporate rapidly before roots drink it, and hot water droplets on leaves can scorch the plant.
ga: Ehi jogbaŋŋ akɛ oooha nu leebi. Nu ni akɛhaa yɛ shwane ni edɔ lɛ mli lɛ haa nu lɛ shwieɔ oya dani shishifãi lɛ nuɔ. Ni nu ni mli edɔ ni shwieɔ baai anɔ lɛ baanyɛ ashã tso lɛ.

english: Why do my yam vines dry up early before the harvest season arrives?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-sweet potatoes lɛ miiho oya dani akpa lɛ?

english: Yam vines dry prematurely when attacked by leaf diseases, soil pests, or prolonged drought. Covering the ground around the yam mound with dry leaves keeps the root zone cool and prevents early drying.
ga: Sweet potato wain tsei lɛ baagbi oya kɛji akɛ folier helai tutua amɛ. Shikpɔŋ nɔ tsɛŋemɔ helai loo hɔmɔ ni sɛɛ tsɛɔ Kɛ́ akɛ baai ni egbi ha shikpɔŋ ni bɔle sweet potato lɛ he lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa shishifã lɛ he lɛ feɔ fɛ̃i ni ehaaa egbi oya.

english: Why do small insects attack my cowpea plants as soon as they sprout from the ground?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ kooloi bibii tutuaa mi-cowpea tsei lɛ kɛji amɛje kpo kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ pɛ?

english: Young sprouts are soft, sweet, and rich in moisture, making them easy food for pests like aphids. Spraying early with safe organic mixes like neem leaf extract protects delicate seedlings during their first few weeks.
ga: Tsei bibii lɛ yɛ bɔdɔɔ, amɛmli ŋɔɔ ni amɛmli nu babaoo. Ehaa niyenii feɔ mlɛo kɛhaa tsɛŋemɔ helai tamɔ aphids. Akɛ shwiemɔ mra. Kɛ nibii ni yɔɔ shweshweeshwe tamɔ neem baa mli nu. Enɛ baaye abua ni abu dumɔwui ni yɔɔ mlɛo lɛ ahe yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ otsii fioo lɛ amli.

english: Why are the leaves of my maize turning yellow and drying up after I sprayed the new chemical I bought from the market?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-abele baai lɛ batsɔ ŋmɔŋ ni amɛgbi beni mikɛ tsofa hee ko ni mihe yɛ jara nɔ lɛ shwie nɔ lɛ?

english: Some chemicals sold on the market are substandard, fake, or too harsh for young crops. When an unsafe product is sprayed, it burns the leaves and stops the plant from making food, causing the leaves to yellow and wither.
ga: Tsofai komɛi ni ahɔ̃ɔ yɛ jara nɔ lɛ ehiii, amɛji amalei, loo amɛhe wa tsɔ kɛha ŋmɔshi nibii bibii. Kɛji akɛ ooshwie nibii ni bɛ shweshweeshwe lɛ Baai lɛ baashã ni amɛbaakpa tso lɛ nihoomɔ. Enɛ haa baai lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ ni amɛgboɔ.

english: Why are all the flowers falling off my pepper plants without producing any peppers?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ fɔfɔii shwieɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ nɔ ni pepper ko kwraa kwɛɛɛ lɛ?

english: Flowers fall off when plants experience sudden stress, which is often caused by harsh or unsafe spray products. The strong chemicals shock the plant, forcing it to drop its flowers to protect itself.
ga: Fɔfɔi lɛ shwieɔ shi kɛ́ tso lɛ na haomɔ trukaa. Bei pii lɛ, aerosol nibii ni mli wa loo ni bɛ shweshweeshwe ji nɔ ni kɛ enɛ baa. Tsofai ni mli wa haa tsei ahe feɔ shoo ni enyɛɔ tsei anɔ koni amɛshwie amɛfɔfɔi lɛ koni amɛkɛbu amɛhe.

english: Why does my land produce less food now even though I keep adding fertilizer every season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mishikpɔŋ lɛ woɔ niyenii fioo lɛ? Nɛgbɛ mikɛ ŋmɔshi nibii woɔ mli daa afi?

english: Overusing bad or low-quality farm inputs can ruin the natural life inside the soil. Over time, the soil becomes exhausted and damaged, making it difficult for crop roots to absorb nutrients even when fertilizer is applied.
ga: Nibii ni ehiii loo ni ehiii ni akɛtsuɔ nii fe nine lɛ baanyɛ afite adebɔɔ mli wala ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ. Beni bei hoɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ baafee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ ni ebaafite. Enɛ haa ewaa ahaa tso shishifãi lɛ akɛ amɛaaŋɔ niyenii mli hewalɛ kɛji akɛ awo amɛ fɔ po.

english: What can I do to bring my soil back to life after bad agrochemical products ruined my farm?
ga: Mɛni mafee koni mahã mishikpɔŋ lɛ aba wala mli ekoŋŋ beni agrochemical nibii gbohii efite miŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ?

english: You can restore ruined soil by resting the land, stopping the use of harsh chemicals, and mixing in rich organic manure or planting leguminous cover crops like beans to naturally feed the ground.
ga: Obaanyɛ okɛ shikpɔŋ ni efite lɛ aku sɛɛ aba kɛtsɔ hejɔɔmɔ nɔ. Kpaa tsofai ni mli wa kɛ nitsumɔ. ni okɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni fa babaoo loo tso ni akɛhaa ŋmɔshi nibii tamɔ ŋmei lɛ afutu mli koni ekɛha shikpɔŋ lɛ niyenii yɛ adebɔɔ naa.

english: I planted new seeds I bought recently, but only a few sprouted while the rest rotted in the soil. What caused this?
ga: Midu dumɔwui heei ni mihe amrɔ nɛɛ. Shi dumɔwui fioo pɛ kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ be mli ni ekrokomɛi lɛ fiteɔ yɛ sũ lɛ mli. Mɛni kɛ enɛ ba?

english: Poor quality or expired seeds sold to farmers often lose their power to sprout. When bad seeds are planted, they cannot withstand soil moisture and will simply rot instead of growing into healthy crops.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, dumɔwui ni ehiii loo ni be eho ni ahɔ̃ɔ ahaa okwaafoi lɛ nyɛɛɛ amɛkwɛ̃. Be ni esa akɛ adu dumɔwui gbohii Amɛnyɛŋ amɛkpɛlɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ ŋmɔtɔ nɔ. ni ebaagbo yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni eeetsɔ tso ni hi jogbaŋŋ.

english: Why are my cassava plants remaining tiny and weak even after a whole year of hard work on the field?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava tsei lɛ daraaa ni amɛbɛ hewalɛ yɛ nitsumɔ ni mitsuɔ waa yɛ ŋmɔ mli afi muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ?

english: When crops are planted using poor planting material or in soil damaged by harmful products, their root systems fail to grow. Without strong roots, the crop cannot feed itself and will stay stunted regardless of how hard you work.
ga: Kɛji akɛ akɛ dumɔ nibii ni ehiii tsuɔ nii kɛduɔ tsei loo yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nibii ni yeɔ mɔ awui efite lɛ nɔ. Amɛshishifãi lɛ ekwɛŋ. Kɛji shishifãi ni mli wa bɛ lɛ, Nibii ni aduɔ lɛ nyɛŋ akwɛ amɛhe ni amɛbaakã he amɛhi shi bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni oootsu nii waa oha.

english: Why are insects still destroying my cowpea crop even after I sprayed them with pest medicine multiple times?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmeii miifite mi-cowpea tsei lɛ lolo eyɛ mli akɛ mikɛ tsofa ni gbeɔ ŋmeii efɔ amɛnɔ shii abɔ moŋ?

english: Using bad, expired, or improperly mixed pest products fails to kill insects. Instead, it allows the pests to survive and continue damaging your crop while wasting your time and money.
ga: Nibii ni ehiii, ni be eho, loo ni akɛfutu mli jogbaŋŋ ni akɛtsuɔ nii lɛ egbeŋ kooloi. Mohu ɔ, e haa nɛ koolohi nɛ a gbeɔ ní ɔmɛ hiɔ si nɛ a yaa nɔ nɛ a puɛɔ o níhi nɛ o duɔ ɔ, nɛ e puɛɔ be kɛ sika.

english: Why did my healthy-looking tomato plants suddenly wilt and die within one day?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato tsei ni tamɔ nɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ gboi trukaa ni amɛgboi yɛ gbi kome mli lɛ?

english: Sudden wilting often occurs when bad soil conditions or harmful residues destroy the water channels inside the main stem, blocking water from moving from the roots to the leaves.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, ŋmɔshi nibii ni shwieɔ shi trukaa lɛ baa kɛji shikpɔŋ ni ehiii loo nibii ni yeɔ mɔ awui ni eshwɛ lɛ kpata nu gbɛi ni yɔɔ tso lɛ shishi lɛ ahiɛ. Etsiɔ nu naa koni ekajɛ shishifãi lɛ amli kɛya baai lɛ amli.

english: How can I know if an agricultural product from the market will hurt my crops before I use it?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male kɛji okwaayeli nibii ni jɛ jara nɔ lɛ baaye miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ awui dani mikɛtsu nii?

english: Always buy from registered dealers, check for official safety approval seals on the package, and test any new product on a tiny corner of your field first to see how the crop reacts before spraying the whole farm.
ga: Be fɛɛ be lɛ, hemɔ kɛjɛ jarayelɔ ko ni aŋma egbɛi awo wolo nɔ lɛ dɛŋ. Kwɛmɔ shweshweeshwefeemɔ he okadi ni yɔɔ nɔ ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ nɔ lɛ. Ni kaa nibii hee fɛɛ nibii heei okwɛ yɛ oŋmɔ lɛ mli he bibioo ko klɛŋklɛŋ koni ona bɔ ni ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ feɔ amɛnii amɛhaa dani okɛ tsofa lɛ afɔ ŋmɔ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.

english: Why are the roots of my cocoa trees turning black and rotting beneath the soil?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ kookoo shishifãi lɛ feɔ ediŋŋ ni amɛgboɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi lɛ?

english: Harmful chemical build-up in the soil combined with poor drainage can create a toxic environment that breeds root-rot fungi, causing the tree roots to decay and die.
ga: Tsofai ni yeɔ mɔ awui ni buaa amɛhe naa yɛ sũ lɛ mli kɛ nu ni hoɔ jogbaŋŋ lɛ baanyɛ aha shihilɛ ni yɔɔ gbeyei aba ni haa shishifãi ni fiteɔ ŋmeii lɛ baa. Nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa ji akɛ, tsei ashishifãi baanyɛ agbo ni amɛgboi.

english: Why are the bottom leaves of my maize plants turning yellow and drying up while the top stays green?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi ŋmãa tsei lɛ ashishigbɛ baai lɛ miifee ŋmɔŋ ni amɛmiigbi yɛ be mli ni ŋwɛi baai lɛ kã he amɛfeɔ ŋmɔŋ lɛ?

english: Yellow lower leaves mean your maize lacks nitrogen, which is the main food plants need to stay green and grow strong. When there is not enough nitrogen in the soil, the plant pulls the remaining nutrients from its oldest bottom leaves to feed the new top leaves, causing the bottom ones to starve.
ga: Baai ni yɔɔ shishigbɛ ni ji ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ o-corn lɛ mli. Eji niyenii titri ni he hiaa tsei koni amɛhi shi eŋɔli ni amɛdara jogbaŋŋ. Beni shikpɔŋ lɛ bɛ nitrogen ni fa bɔ ni sa Tsei lɛ gbalaa niyenii ni eshwɛ kɛjɛɔ shishigbɛ baai ni etsɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ amli koni amɛkɛha ŋwɛi baai heei lɛ niyenii. Enɛ haa hɔmɔ yeɔ baa ni yɔɔ shishigbɛ lɛ.

english: When is the right time for me to put fertilizer on my crops after they start growing?
ga: Mɛɛ be ji be ni sa ni esa akɛ mikɛ ŋmɔshi nibii awo miŋmɔshi nibii amli beni amɛbɔi kwɛ̃mɔ sɛɛ?

english: Fertilizer works best when given in two stages: a small amount early at planting to help roots grow strong, and a second portion when the crop is growing fast or preparing to flower so it has energy to produce big cobs or fruits.
ga: Nibii ni akɛwoɔ ŋmɔ mli lɛ tsuɔ nii jogbaŋŋ kɛ́ akɛha yɛ gbɛi enyɔ nɔ: fioo ko yɛ dumɔ shishijee mli koni eye ebua ni ewaje shishifãi lɛ. kɛ be ni ji enyɔ lɛ, be mli ni tso lɛ miida oya loo eesaa ehe koni ewo fɔfɔi bɔni afee ni ená hewalɛ ni ekɛwo ŋmeii loo aduawai wuji.

english: Why are my tomato flowers falling off the plants without turning into fruit?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi tomato fɔfɔi lɛ miiho kɛmiijɛ tso lɛ nɔ ni amɛtsɔko aduawai lɛ?

english: Tomato flowers drop when the plant gets stressed by extreme heat, long dry spells, or low nutrients like phosphorus. When stressed, the plant drops its flowers to save energy for its own survival.
ga: Tomato fɔfɔi lɛ baagbee shi kɛ́ hulutsoo ni naa wa waa hao tso lɛ. be kakadaŋŋ ni egbiɔ loo niyenii mli hewalɛ ni faaa tamɔ fɔsfɔs be mli ni haomɔ Tsei baashwie fɔfɔi koni amɛkɛto hewalɛ he kɛha amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwala.

english: Why do my young cocoa trees shed many small green pods before they grow big?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi cacao tso bibioo lɛ miijie ŋmeii bibii ni yɔɔ ŋmɔji amli lɛ? Mɛi enyiɛ dani etsɔ agbo?

english: This is often a natural process called cherelle wilt, where the cocoa tree drops extra pods it cannot afford to feed due to limited water or nutrients. However, excessive pod dropping can also be caused by insect bites or fungal attacks.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, enɛ ji adebɔɔ mli nifeemɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Cherelle Wilt, ni cacao tso lɛ shwieɔ ŋmeii ni fa fe nine ni anyɛɛɛ akwɛ nɔ yɛ nu loo niyenii mli hewalɛ ni faaa lɛ hewɔ. Shi kɛlɛ, ŋmeii ni shwieɔ mɔ loo ŋmeii ni yeɔ mɔ lɛ baanyɛ aha pod lɛ shwieɔ shi fe nine.

english: Why do my maize crops grow thin and yield smaller cobs when I plant multiple seeds close together in one hole?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-ŋmãa lɛ mli tseee ni ewoɔ ŋmeii fioo pɛ beni midu dumɔwui babaoo ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe yɛ bu kome mli lɛ?

english: When seeds are planted too close together, their roots fight each other for limited water, sunlight, and soil food. Giving each plant proper space allows its roots to spread and gather enough food to produce large, full cobs.
ga: Kɛ dumɔwui lɛ bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ lɛ Shishifãi lɛ wuɔ koni amɛná nu, hulu la, kɛ niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ. Kɛ́ aha tso fɛɛ tso he ko ni sa lɛ, ehaa eshishifãi lɛ gbɛɔ eshwaa ni ebuaa niyenii ni fa bɔ ni sa naa koni ekɛ ŋmeii wuji ni eyi obɔ aba.

english: Why do my cassava plants grow very tall stems with small tubers underground?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava lɛ yɛ ŋmeii ni kɛlɛ waa kɛ ŋmeii bibii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ shishi lɛ?

english: Cassava plants grow tall and thin when planted in excessive shade or when given too much nitrogen relative to potassium. The plant uses all its energy to grow stems reaching for sunlight instead of storing energy in the root tubers.
ga: Yucca tsei lɛ daraa ni amɛfeɔ mlɛo kɛji akɛ amɛkwɛ̃ yɛ hulutsoo be mli tsɔ loo kɛ́ amɛná nitrogen babaoo fe potassium. Tsei kɛ amɛhewalɛ fɛɛ tsuɔ nii koni amɛkɛha amɛshishifãi lɛ atsɔ hulu la moŋ fe ni amɛkɛ hewalɛ baato amɛshishifãi lɛ amli.

english: Twisted and discolored leaves are symptoms of Cassava Mosaic Disease, caused by a virus spread by tiny whiteflies. The virus damages the plant's ability to turn sunlight into food, leading to reduced root growth.
ga: Baai ni etsilɛ ni etsake amɛhe lɛ ji yucca mosaic hela lɛ he okadii. Virus ko ni ŋmeii bibii yɛŋ gbɛɔ eshwaa lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛbaa. Virus lɛ fiteɔ nyɛmɔ ni tso lɛ yɔɔ ni ekɛtsakeɔ hulu la lɛ ewoɔ niyenii mli lɛ. Nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa ji shishifãi lɛ adalɛ ni baa shi.

english: Why am I seeing ragged holes on the leaves of my young maize crop every morning?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ minaa pores yɛ mi-baby corn baa lɛ nɔ daa leebi lɛ?

english: Holes on young maize leaves are usually caused by caterpillars like the Fall Armyworm. They hide deep inside the center whorl of the leaf funnel during the hot daytime and come out at night to chew on the tender foliage.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, ŋmeii tamɔ Fall Armyworm lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ ŋmeii ni yɔɔ ŋmeii bibii amli lɛ baa. Amɛteeɔ amɛhe amɛwoɔ baa lɛ teŋgbɛ ŋwɛi ŋta lɛ mli shɔŋŋ yɛ gbii ni hulu tsoɔ waa lɛ amli. ni amɛjeɔ kpo gbɛkɛ koni amɛbaye baai ni yɔɔ blɛoo lɛ.

english: Why does planting groundnuts on my farm make the soil better for maize in the next season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmeii ni aduɔ yɛ miŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ haa shikpɔŋ lɛ feɔ nɔ ni hi kɛha afi ni baa lɛ mli ŋmeii lɛ?

english: Groundnuts and beans belong to the legume family, which has special bacteria on their roots that capture nitrogen from the air and trap it in the soil. When the crop dies, that natural fertilizer remains in the soil to feed the next crop.
ga: Peanuts kɛ beans ji legumes ni yɔɔ bacteria krɛdɛɛ ko yɛ amɛshishifãi ni mɔɔ nitrogen kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni ekɛwoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Kɛ ŋmɔshi nibii gboi Nakai adebɔɔ mli ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ baakã shikpɔŋ lɛ mli koni ekɛha ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ niyenii.

english: Why do seeds saved from last year's hybrid maize yield smaller crops than the original seeds I purchased?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ dumɔwui ni mikɛto kɛjɛ afi ni ho lɛ mli ŋmãa ni akɛfee ŋmãa lɛ mli lɛ woɔ yibii fioo fe shishijee dumɔwui ni mihe lɛ?

english: Hybrid seeds are specially bred from two unique parent lines to give high yields in the first generation only. When you save and replant those seeds, the offspring lose that special vigor, resulting in uneven growth and lower yield.
ga: Akwɛɔ dumɔwui ni akɛfee ekome lɛ amli yɛ gbɛ krɛdɛɛ ko nɔ kɛjɛɔ fɔlɔi akui srɔtoi enyɔ amli koni amɛwo yibii babaoo yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ yinɔ lɛ pɛ mli. Kɛji okɛ nakai dumɔwui lɛ to ni okɛdu ekoŋŋ lɛ Seshi lɛ baafite hewalɛ kroko. Enɛ haa shweremɔ ni ejaaa kɛ nibii ni anáa lɛ baa shi.

english: Why do my young cocoa seedlings die when I plant them in an open field without trees around?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-kokoo tsei bibii lɛ gboiɔ kɛ́ midu amɛ yɛ ŋmɔ ko ni tsei bɛ amɛhe lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Young cocoa trees need shade because direct sunlight burns their delicate leaves and dries out the soil quickly. Planting shade crops like plantains or leaving some tall trees gives them cool shade and protection while they grow strong root systems.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii lɛ hia hulutsoo ejaakɛ hulu la ni tsoɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ shãa baai ni yɔɔ mlɛo lɛ ni ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ gĩɔ oya. Tsei ni haa hulutsoo baa tamɔ plantains ni aduɔ loo tsei kakadaji ni ashiɔ yɛ sɛɛ. Enɛ baaha tso lɛ aná hulutsoo kɛ hebuu yɛ be mli ni ehaa tso lɛ shishifãi ni mli wa.

english: Why are there holes in my young maize leaves and small worms hiding inside the plants?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-baby corn baai kɛ mi-worms bibii lɛ yɛ bu ni akɛtee tso lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Those small worms are likely fall armyworms that feed on soft, young maize leaves. They hide inside the central tube of the plant during the day to eat the leaves, which slows down the plant's growth if they are not treated early.
ga: Ekolɛ nɛkɛ ŋmeii bibii nɛɛ ji asraafoi ŋmeii ni yeɔ ŋmeii bibii ni yɔɔ blɛoo lɛ. Amɛteɔ amɛhe amɛwoɔ tsei lɛ ateŋ tsɔne lɛ mli yɛ gbi lɛ mli koni amɛye baai lɛ. Enɛ baaha tso lɛ dalɛ aya hiɛ fioo kɛji akɛ atsaaa lɛ mra.

english: Why do my elders tell me to plant groundnuts or beans on the same land where I planted maize last year?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ okɛɛ mi akɛ madu ŋmãa yɛ shikpɔŋ ni adu ŋmãa yɛ nɔ nyɛsɛɛ afi lɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ lɛ?

english: Groundnuts and beans belong to the legume family, which naturally feeds the soil by taking nitrogen from the air and storing it in the earth. Planting them helps refresh the soil so your next maize crop can grow well without needing as much commercial fertilizer.
ga: Peanuts kɛ beans ji ŋmeii ni haa shikpɔŋ lɛ niyenii yɛ adebɔɔ naa kɛtsɔ nitrogen ni amɛjieɔ kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni amɛkɛtoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ nɔ. Dumɔ haa shikpɔŋ lɛ feɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ bɔni afee ni o-abele ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ anyɛ ada jogbaŋŋ ni jarayeli ŋmɔshi nibii babaoo he ehiaaa.

english: Yam plants are climbing vines that need sunlight to make food for growing big tubers underground. Staking lifts the leaves up toward the sun and keeps them off the wet soil where diseases and rot can easily spread.
ga: Sweet potato tsei ji wain tsei ni kwɔɔ ni he hiaa hulu la koni amɛná niyenii kɛha bulb agbo ni kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi lɛ. Staking woɔ baai lɛ anɔ kɛyaa hulu la mli ni ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shwieɔ shi, he ni helai kɛ fitemɔ baanyɛ agbɛ ashwã oya lɛ.

english: How do I know that my cassava roots are fully grown and ready to be dug up from the farm?
ga: Te ooofee tɛŋŋ ole kɛji akɛ ŋmei shishifãi lɛ ekwɛ̃ jogbaŋŋ ni esa akɛ atsa yɛ ŋmɔ lɛ mli?

english: You can tell cassava is maturing when the lower leaves turn yellow and fall off, leaving bare stems with leaves mostly at the top. You can also carefully dig around the base of one plant to check if the tubers are thick enough for harvest.
ga: Obaanyɛ ona akɛ ŋmei lɛ egbɔ kɛji shishigbɛ baai lɛ tsɔ ŋmɔŋ ni amɛgbee shi. Tso lɛ yitso lɛ bɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ni eyɛ baai babaoo yɛ nɔ. Obaanyɛ okɛ ohe awo mli hu. Okɛ hiɛdɔɔ atswa tso kome shishifãi koni ona kɛji ŋmeii lɛ amli eyi bɔ ni sa ni abaanyɛ akpa.

english: Why do small shoots grow around the base of my plantain tree, and should I cut them off?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmeii lɛ daraaa lɛ? Koni eda yɛ mi plantain shishitoo lɛ he Ni ani esa akɛ mafo mli?

english: Those small shoots are called suckers, which are baby plantain plants. If you leave too many of them growing at once, they will steal water and food from the mother tree, so it is best to cut off the extra ones and keep only one or two strong suckers.
ga: Atsɛɔ nakai ŋmeii bibii lɛ akɛ ŋmeii. ni ji plantain tso bibioo ko Kɛji oha tsei babaoo kwɛ̃ shikome lɛ, Amɛjuɔ nu kɛ niyenii kɛjɛɔ tso lɛ nyɛ lɛ dɛŋ. No hewɔ lɛ, ehi jogbaŋŋ akɛ ooofolɔ tsei ni fa fe nine lɛ ni okɛ tso kome loo enyɔ pɛ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ahi shi.

english: Why do my pepper leaves droop down in the hot afternoon even if I watered them in the morning?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper baai lɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ shwane ni hulu lɛ miitso waa be mli ni esa akɛ mafee nakai lɛ? Higbɛ esa akɛ awo nu yɛ leebi?

english: When the afternoon sun is very hot, pepper leaves lose water faster through evaporation than the roots can pull up from the soil. The leaves droop to protect themselves from losing more moisture, and they usually stand back up in the cooler evening.
ga: Kɛ shwane hulu lɛ mli edɔ waa lɛ, Pepper baai lɛ laajeɔ nu oya fe nu ni hoɔ kɛjɛɔ shishifãi lɛ amli ni baanyɛ agbala lɛ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ. Baai lɛ shwieɔ shi koni amɛbu amɛhe kɛjɛ ŋmɔtɔ ni fiteɔ lɛ he. ni bei pii lɛ, eteɔ shi yɛ gbɛkɛ ni hulutsoo be yɔɔ mli lɛ mli.

english: How can I tell if the ground has enough moisture for me to plant my seeds after the early rains start?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male kɛji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔ bɔ ni sa ni manyɛ madu dumɔwui yɛ be mli ni nugbɔ ebɔi nɛmɔ sɛɛ?

english: Squeeze a handful of topsoil from your farm into a ball. If it holds its shape without dripping water and easily crumbles when you tap it, the soil has the right amount of moisture for seeds to sprout without rotting.
ga: Nyɛɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ sũ ko ni yɔɔ oŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ nɔ ofee bɔɔlu. Kɛji ehiɛ egbɛhe lɛ mli ni nu shwieee shi ni efoɔ mlɛo kɛji ota he. Enɛ tsɔɔ akɛ sũ lɛ yɛ nu ni sa bɔ ni sa koni dumɔwui lɛ akwɛ̃ ni amɛfiteee.

english: Tomato flowers drop when temperatures get too high, when the soil stays too dry, or when bees do not pollinate them. Excessive heat stresses the plant, causing it to drop flowers to conserve energy instead of producing fruit.
ga: Tomato fɔfɔi lɛ baagbee shi kɛji hulutsoo be lɛ mli wa tsɔ. Be mli ni shikpɔŋ lɛ mli egbi tsɔ lolo Aloo be mli ni ŋmeii efeee pollination. Dɔlɛ ni fe nine lɛ haa tsei lɛ haoɔ. Enɛ haa fɔfɔi lɛ shwieɔ shi koni amɛkɛbu hewalɛ he moŋ fe ni amɛaawo yibii.

english: Why do weeds grow faster and greener than my crops after I put fertilizer on my farm?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ jwɛi lɛ daa oya ni efeɔ ŋmɔŋ fe miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ beni mikɛ ŋmɔshi nibii wo miŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Weeds have strong, aggressive roots that quickly suck up water and fertilizer nutrients before your crops can reach them. Clearing weeds right before applying fertilizer ensures your main crops get all the food instead of the weeds.
ga: Jwɛi lɛ yɛ shishifãi ni mli wa, ni yɔɔ basabasa. Enɛ shwieɔ nu kɛ ŋmɔshi nibii amli oya dani ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ shɛɔ amɛhe. Kɛ́ ogbe jwɛi dani okɛ ŋmɔshi nibii awo mli lɛ, ebaaha otso titri lɛ aná niyenii fɛɛ yɛ jwɛi lɛ najiaŋ.

english: Young cocoa plants cannot handle direct, intense sunlight. Plantain leaves act as living umbrellas, providing the necessary shade and humidity until the cocoa trees grow strong enough to withstand full sun.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii nyɛŋ akpɛlɛ hulu la ni naa wa ni tsoɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ nɔ. Plantain baai tsuɔ nii akɛ hulutsoo. Ha hulutsoo kɛ fɛ̃i ni he hia kɛyashi kookoo tso lɛ baatsɔ hewalɛ bɔ ni sa ni enyɛ eŋmɛ hulutsoo be lɛ naa.

english: Yellowing lower leaves usually indicate a lack of nitrogen in the soil. Maize needs nitrogen to stay green and healthy, so when the soil runs low, the plant moves available nitrogen to its upper leaves, causing the bottom leaves to turn yellow.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, shishigbɛ baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ sũ lɛ mli. Nitrogen he miihia ŋmãa koni ehi shi eŋɔli ni ehiɛ hewalɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ́ shikpɔŋ fioo pɛ eshwɛ Tso lɛ tsiɔ nitrogen ni yɔɔ lɛ kɛyaa baai ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ anɔ. Nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa ji akɛ, baai ni yɔɔ shishi lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ.

english: Why do small caterpillars hide and eat inside the funnel leaf of my young corn plants?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmeii bibii kɛ amɛhe teeɔ ni amɛyeɔ nii yɛ mi-ŋmei tsei bibii lɛ amli ŋmeii lɛ amli lɛ?

english: Those are Fall Armyworms. They seek out the tender, sweet inner whorl of young corn plants because it offers shelter from heat and predators while providing the most nutritious leaf tissue.
ga: Amɛji Fall Asraafoi. Amɛtaoɔ ŋmãa tsei bibii lɛ amli ŋmeii ni yɔɔ blɛoo ni ŋɔɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ ehaa mɔ he jɔ̃ɔ ehe kɛjɛɔ dɔlɛ kɛ kooloi ni yeɔ mɔ awui lɛ ahe. Yɛ nakai beaŋ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ehaa tso lɛ yibii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ.

english: Yam vines need maximum sunlight on their leaves to build big tubers underground. Staking holds the leaves up to catch light and keeps them off wet ground, which prevents leaves from rotting or catching soil diseases.
ga: Sweet potato wain tsei lɛ he miihia hulu la babaoo yɛ amɛbaai lɛ anɔ koni amɛfee shikpɔŋ shishi ŋmeii wuji. Staking yeɔ ebuaa ni ekɛ baai lɛ fĩɔ la mli ni ehaaa amɛfee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ. Enɛ baaye abua ni baai lɛ akafite loo hela akabote shikpɔŋ lɛ mli.

english: Why do my cassava roots rot underground if heavy rain leaves water standing on my farm?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmeii shishifãi lɛ fiteɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi kɛji nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ ha nu shwie ŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Cassava roots need air in the soil to stay alive. When water sits on the field for days, it cuts off oxygen to the roots, causing them to suffocate and rot.
ga: Cassava shishifãi taoɔ kɔɔyɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli koni amɛhi shi. Kɛ nu lɛ ehi ŋmɔ lɛ nɔ gbii babaoo Efoɔ kɔɔyɔɔ ni haa wala yibii lɛ yaa shishifãi lɛ amli. ni kɛ ŋmɔlɔ kɛ fitemɔ baa

english: Growing cassava continuously on the same soil drains specific nutrients that cassava relies on and allows soil pests and diseases targeting cassava to build up in high numbers.
ga: Kasava ni aduɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ kome nɔ be fɛɛ be lɛ haa niyenii pɔtɛɛ ni ekɛ ehe fɔ̃ɔ nɔ lɛ hoɔ. ni ehaa tsɛŋemɔ helai kɛ helai ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni tsɔɔ ŋmei lɛ nɔ lɛ buaa amɛhe naa babaoo.

english: Why do my pepper plants drop their flowers without producing any peppers during hot weather?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ shwieɔ fɔfɔi ni ekɛ pepper ko baaa yɛ be mli ni hulu lɛ tsoɔ waa lɛ?

english: Extreme heat stresses the plant, causing it to shed its flowers to conserve water and energy for its own survival rather than using energy to grow fruit.
ga: Dɔlɛ ni naa wa waa kɛ haomɔ baa tsei anɔ. Nɔ ni jɛ mli ba ji akɛ, esa akɛ tsei afɔse amɛ fɔfɔi lɛ koni amɛkɛ nu kɛ hewalɛ ato kɛha amɛ wala. Yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni akɛ hewalɛ baatsu nii kɛdu aduawai

english: Why do my cowpea leaves fold up or curl during the hottest part of the afternoon?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cowpea baai lɛ shwieɔ shi loo amɛfoɔ amɛhe yɛ shwane be ni hulu lɛ tsoɔ waa lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Folding leaves is a natural survival reaction. By turning leaf surfaces away from direct sunlight, the plant reduces water loss through evaporation during peak daytime heat.
ga: Baai ni afolɔ mli lɛ ji adebɔɔ mli wala yiwalaheremɔ nifeemɔ. Tsakemɔ ni baa lɛ hiɛ ni ajieɔ kɛjɛɔ hulu la ni tsoɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ he Tsei haa nu ni laajeɔ lɛ baa shi kɛtsɔɔ la ni hoɔ yɛ hulutsoo be mli lɛ nɔ.

english: Why do my tomato plants get dark spots on their leaves and wither during the rainy season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ tomato tsei lɛ ahe yɔɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ yɛ amɛbaai lɛ anɔ ni amɛgboɔ yɛ nugbɔ be mli lɛ?

english: High moisture and rain splashes spread fungal spores onto tomato leaves. Fungus thrives in cool, humid conditions, causing leaf spot and blight.
ga: Fɛ̃i ni naa wa kɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ gbɛ fungal spores eshwã tomato baai lɛ anɔ. Mold shwereɔ yɛ hei ni mli ejɔ ni ŋmɔtɔ yɔɔ. Ekɛ baa mli ŋmɔtɔ kɛ ŋmɔtɔ baa.

english: Why does covering the base of my garden plants with dry grass keep the soil damp for longer?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ni kɛ́ mikɛ jwɛi ni egbi ha tsei ni yɔɔ mibɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ ashishi lɛ, ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shwieɔ shi be kakadaŋŋ lɛ?

english: Dry grass acts as mulch, creating a protective barrier that stops direct sunlight from baking the earth and evaporating water out of the soil.
ga: Jwɛi ni egbi lɛ tsuɔ nii akɛ mulch. Ehaa nɔ ko ni buɔ mɔ he ni tsiɔ hulu la ni baa tɛ̃ɛ lɛ naa koni ekaha shikpɔŋ lɛ agbi ni nu ni jɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ akafee lasu.

english: How do I know if my maize crops are suffering from lack of water before they completely dry up?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male akɛ nu ni faaa yɛ mi-ŋmãa lɛ mli miipiŋ dani egbi kwraa?

english: Maize plants show water stress by curling their leaves inward into tight tubes during the hot afternoon to prevent moisture loss. If the leaves remain curled into the cool evening, the crop urgently needs water.
ga: Abɛi tsei jieɔ nu he haomɔ kpo kɛtsɔ amɛbaai lɛ ni amɛfoɔ amɛmli amɛwoɔ tsɔnei ni mli wa mli yɛ shwane ni mli edɔ lɛ mli koni ŋmɔtɔ akaje mli lɛ nɔ. Kɛji akɛ baai lɛ ebɔle amɛhe lolo yɛ gbɛkɛ ni fɛ̃i yɔɔ mli lɛ, Nu he miihia Dumɔwui oya.

english: When cassava lacks nutrients like nitrogen in the soil, it pulls energy from its older bottom leaves to feed the young growing leaves at the top, causing the lower leaves to yellow and drop off.
ga: Be mli ni ŋmei bɛ niyenii tamɔ nitrogen yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Ejieɔ hewalɛ kɛjɛɔ shishigbɛ baai ni edara lɛ amli ni ekɛhaa baai bibii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ. Enɛ haa baai ni yɔɔ shishigbɛ lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ ni amɛshwieɔ shi.

english: Why do the leaves of my cowpea plants fold up tightly during the middle of the afternoon?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cowpea baai lɛ shwieɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ shwane mli lɛ?

english: Cowpea leaves fold up on hot afternoons to reduce the surface area exposed to direct sunlight, helping the plant conserve water and protect itself from extreme heat.
ga: Cowpea baai lɛ fɔ̃ɔ amɛhe yɛ shwane ni hulu lɛ tsoɔ waa lɛ mli koni ekɛba he ni hulu la lɛ shɛɔ nɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ shi. Eyeɔ ebuaa tsei ni amɛbuɔ nu he ni amɛbuɔ amɛhe kɛjɛɔ dɔlɛ ni naa wa he.

english: Why are my pepper plants growing tall and thin instead of becoming bushy and strong?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ daa ni efeɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ moŋ fe ni eeefee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ ni ehe wa lɛ?

english: Pepper plants stretch tall and slender when they are shaded or planted too close together, as they are competing for light and reaching upward toward the sun.
ga: Pepper tsei lɛ daraa ni amɛfeɔ mlɛo kɛji awo amɛ shade loo adu amɛ yɛ he ko ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ. Ejaakɛ amɛmiitao la ni amɛmiikwɛ ŋwɛi kɛmiiya hulu lɛ he.

english: Why are my tomato plants producing plenty of flowers but dropping them without making any tomatoes?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato tso lɛ woɔ fɔfɔi babaoo shi eshiɔ ni ewooo tomato ko kwraa lɛ?

english: Tomato flowers drop off without setting fruit when temperatures are too high, when there is too much nitrogen fertilizer, or when insects fail to pollinate the blossoms.
ga: Tomato fɔfɔi lɛ baagbee shi ni amɛwooo yibii kɛ́ hulutsoo be lɛ mli wa tsɔ. Be mli ni nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii babaoo yɔɔ loo be mli ni kooloi bibii nyɛɛɛ afee fɔfɔii amli ŋmɔtɔ

english: Why are small young cocoa pods turning black and shriveling up right on the tree trunk?
