english: No, there is currently no chemical cure or medicine that can cure a tree once it is infected with cocoa swollen shoot disease.
ga: Dabi, amrɔ nɛɛ tsofai loo tsofai komɛi bɛ ni baanyɛ atsa tso ko kɛji akɛ kookoo ŋmɔshi nibii ni efuu lɛ emɔ lɛ.

english: If there is no cure for swollen shoot, what should I do to my cocoa tree if it catches the disease?
ga: Kɛji tso lɛ efuu lɛ, anyɛɛɛ atsa lɛ. Mɛni esa akɛ mafee kɛji akɛ hela lɛ emɔ kookoo tso lɛ?

english: The recommended solution is to completely cut down the infected tree and its immediate neighbors to stop the virus from spreading to the rest of your healthy cocoa farm.
ga: Nɔ ni atsɔɔ akɛ atsu he nii ji ni afo tsei ni hela lɛ emɔ amɛ lɛ kɛ hei ni bɛŋkɛ jɛmɛ lɛ kwraa koni hela lɛ akagbɛ ashwã hei krokomɛi. ni ji kookoo ŋmɔji ni hi kɛha ohewalɛ

english: Does leaving my farm overgrown with weeds make my cocoa trees more likely to get swollen shoot?
ga: Ani kɛ́ mishi miŋmɔ lɛ mli ni jwɛi eyi mli obɔ lɛ, ebaaha mi-cacao tsei lɛ aná hegbɛ ni amɛkwɛ̃?

english: Yes, overgrown weeds create a friendly environment for insect pests like mealybugs to hide and multiply, increasing the risk of virus spread.
ga: No ji anɔkwale, jwɛi ni ekwɛ̃ fe nine lɛ haa shihilɛ ni mli wa baa koni kooloi ni yeɔ mɔ awui tamɔ mealybugs lɛ ahi shi ni amɛshwere. Ehaa oshara ni yɔɔ akɛ hela lɛ gbɛɔ eshwaa lɛ yaa hiɛ.

english: How can I protect my new cocoa farm so it doesn't easily catch swollen shoot disease?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ mabu kookoo ŋmɔji heei ahe koni amɛkafee ŋmeii ni efuu?

english: You can protect your farm by planting hybrid cocoa varieties recommended by COCOBOD that tolerate diseases better, keeping proper shade trees, and regularly controlling insect pests.
ga: Obaanyɛ obu oŋmɔ lɛ he kɛtsɔ cocoa hybrid henɔi ni COCOBOD woɔ he ŋaa ni helai nyɛɔ amɛyeɔ amɛhe lɛ ni ooodu lɛ nɔ. Kwɛmɔ tsei lɛ anɔ jogbaŋŋ koni amɛná hulutsoo ni sa. ni akudɔ kooloi ni yeɔ mɔ awui lɛ daa

english: Why do my tomato plants wilt in the afternoon heat even when I water the soil?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato tsei lɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ shwane mli eyɛ mli akɛ mikɛ nu woɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ moŋ?

english: When temperatures are very high, tomato plants lose water faster through their leaves than the roots can suck it up from the ground. It can also mean a soil disease is blocking the tubes inside the stem that carry water.
ga: Kɛji hulutsoo be lɛ mli wa waa lɛ Tomato tsei lɛ laajeɔ nu kɛtsɔɔ amɛbaai lɛ amli oya fe bɔ ni amɛshishifãi lɛ baanyɛ ajie kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ebaanyɛ etsɔɔ hu akɛ hela ko ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ tsiɔ paipii ni yɔɔ tso lɛ mli ni kɛ nu yaa lɛ anaa.

english: Why do my pepper plants drop their flowers during very hot weather?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ shwieɔ fɔfɔi yɛ be mli ni hulu lɛ tsoɔ waa lɛ?

english: Extreme heat stresses pepper plants, forcing them to drop flowers to save energy and water. Adding grass mulch around the roots keeps the soil cooler and helps the plant retain its blossoms.
ga: Dɔlɛ ni naa wa lɛ nyɛɔ pepper tsei anɔ koni amɛshwie amɛfɔfɔi lɛ koni amɛkɛbu hewalɛ kɛ nu he. Mulching ni akɛwoɔ shishifãi lɛ ahe lɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ mli jɔɔ, ni eyeɔ ebuaa tso lɛ ni ehiɛɔ efɔfɔi lɛ amli.

english: Why do my local cassava varieties survive dry weather better than the new high-yielding varieties?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mimaŋ ŋmei henɔ lɛ hiɔ shi yɛ shihilɛi ni mli egbi mli jogbaŋŋ fe ŋmei henɔ hee ni woɔ yibii babaoo lɛ?

english: Traditional local cassava varieties have deeper root systems suited for surviving long droughts, while many high-yielding varieties put their energy into fast top-growth and need steady water to perform well.
ga: Cassava henɔ ni yɔɔ jɛmɛ lɛ yɛ shishifãi ni mli kwɔ ni sa jogbaŋŋ kɛha hɔmɔ ni sɛɛ tsɛɔ lɛ mlihilɛ. Yɛ be mli ni ŋmeii srɔtoi babaoo ni woɔ yibii babaoo kɛ hewalɛ tsuɔ nii koni amɛkwɛ̃ oya ni amɛbiɔ nu ni yaa nɔ daa koni amɛtsu nii jogbaŋŋ lɛ,.

english: Maize leaves turn yellow at the bottom when the soil lacks nitrogen. The plant steals nitrogen from its older bottom leaves to feed the young top leaves, showing that the farm needs organic manure or nitrogen fertilizer.
ga: Abɛi baai lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ yɛ shishigbɛ kɛ́ nitrogen bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Tsei juɔ nitrogen kɛjɛɔ shishigbɛ baai ni egbɔ lɛ amli koni amɛkɛha ŋwɛi baai bibii lɛ niyenii. Etsɔɔ akɛ ŋmɔ lɛ he miihia organic ŋmɔshi nibii loo nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii.

english: Why do my sweet potato plants produce huge green leaves but very small tubers underneath?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi sweet potato tso lɛ yɛ baai agboi ni yɔɔ ŋmɔji amli lɛ? Shi yitso bibioo ko yɛ shishi?

english: When soil has too much nitrogen, sweet potatoes put all their energy into growing leaves on top instead of storing starch in the roots underground.
ga: Kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ nitrogen babaoo lɛ Sweet potatoes kɛ amɛhewalɛ fɛɛ woɔ baai ni miida lɛ amli moŋ fe ni amɛkɛ starch baato amɛshishi shishi shishifãi lɛ amli.

english: Why does planting groundnuts on my land help my maize grow better the following season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmeii ni aduɔ yɛ mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ baaye abua ni mi-ŋmei lɛ akwɛ̃ jogbaŋŋ yɛ be ni baa lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Groundnuts are legumes that naturally pull nitrogen from the air and trap it in the soil through their roots, leaving free fertilizer behind for the next crop.
ga: Peanuts ji ŋmeii ni jieɔ nitrogen kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli yɛ adebɔɔ naa ni amɛtsɔɔ amɛshishifãi lɛ amli amɛwoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Shi ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ kɛha dumɔ ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ.

english: Why do my cocoa trees drop so many of their flowers before any pods form?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi cacao tsei lɛ miiwo fɔfɔi babaoo dani ŋmeii lɛ jeɔ kpo lɛ?

english: Cocoa trees shed flowers when they suffer from shade loss or lack of moisture, or when tiny pollinating insects called midges are not available to fertilize the blossoms.
ga: Cocoa tsei lɛ fɔɔ fɔfɔi kɛji amɛmiipiŋ yɛ hulutsoo loo ŋmɔtɔ ni bɛ amɛhe lɛ hewɔ. Aloo kɛ́ kooloi bibii shwieɔ fɔfɔi lɛ anɔ Nɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ midge lɛ nyɛŋ afee efɔfɔi lɛ fɔmɔ nii.

english: Why do my orange fruits fall off the tree while they are still green and sour?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-orange lɛ miiho kɛmiijɛ tso lɛ nɔ be mli ni amɛji eŋɔli ni amɛmli edɔ lolo lɛ?

english: Early fruit drop is usually caused by fruit flies laying eggs inside the fruit or sudden dry spells. Clearing dropped fruits from the ground prevents pests from multiplying and attacking remaining oranges.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, nɔ ni kɛ aduawai ni shwieɔ shi mra lɛ baa ji aduawai amli ŋmeii ni woɔ ŋmeii yɛ aduawai lɛ amli loo hulutsoo be ni baa trukaa lɛ. Kɛ́ ojie aduawai ni egbee shi kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ebaatsi kooloi ni yeɔ mɔ awui lɛ anaa koni amɛkafa babaoo ni amɛtutua citrus tsei ni eshwɛ lɛ.

english: Why do my cowpea plants grow plenty of leaves but very few seed pods?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cowpea tso lɛ baa babaoo shi dumɔwui fioo pɛ yɔɔ mli lɛ?

english: Cowpeas produce fewer pods if the soil is given high-nitrogen fertilizer or if the plants are shaded too much by trees, preventing proper flowering.
ga: Cowpeas baaha ŋmeii fioo pɛ aba kɛji akɛ akɛ nitrogen babaoo wo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. aloo kɛji tsei babaoo ewo tso lɛ he ŋmɔlɔ Ebaatsi amɛ gbɛ koni amɛkawo fɔfɔi jogbaŋŋ.

english: Why do my yam tubers turn out short and twisted instead of long and straight?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi sweet potato tubers lɛ ji kukuji ni ebɔle ehe moŋ fe ni eeefee kakadaŋŋ ni eja lɛ?

english: Yam tubers become misshapen when the soil underneath is too hard or stony. Loosening the soil into high, soft mounds lets the tuber expand straight downwards easily.
ga: Sweet potato ŋmeii lɛ fiteɔ kɛji shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ amɛshishi lɛ mli wa tsɔ loo eyɛ tɛi tsɔ. Kɛ́ ajie shikpɔŋ lɛ ni efee gɔŋ ni yɔɔ blɛoo ni nɔ kwɔ lɛ, ehaa ŋmeii lɛ shwieɔ shi tɛ̃ɛ kɛyaa shishigbɛ mlɛo.

english: Young cocoa trees need shade to survive because direct sunlight scorches their soft leaves and dries out the soil moisture quickly before their roots are fully established.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii lɛ he miihia amɛ hulutsoo koni amɛhi shi ejaakɛ hulu la ni tsoɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ shãa amɛbaai bibii lɛ ni ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nu lɛ gbɛ́ɔ oya dani amɛshishifãi lɛ shwereɔ kwraa.

english: Why do I need to cut off some of the extra branches from my mature cocoa trees?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ehe hiaa ni mafolɔ cacao tso ni eda lɛ niji ni fa fe nine lɛ?

english: Pruning allows air and sunlight to flow through the tree canopy, which prevents fungal diseases like black pod from spreading and encourages the tree to produce more flowers and pods.
ga: Tso lɛ mlifomɔ haa kɔɔyɔɔ kɛ hulu la hoɔ kɛtsɔɔ tso lɛ yiteŋ. Enɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni tsɛŋemɔ helai tamɔ black pods lɛ akagbɛ eshwa. ni ekanyaa tsei lɛ koni amɛwo fɔfɔi kɛ ŋmeii babaoo

english: Yellow leaves are usually a sign that the soil lacks nitrogen, which is the essential nutrient maize needs to build green leaves and grow strong stems.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ lɛ ji okadi ni tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Enɛ ji niyenii ni he hiaa ni he hiaa ŋmãa koni enyɛ ekwɛ baai eŋɔli kɛ ŋmeii ni wa.

english: What is causing the tiny holes in my maize leaves and the brown dirt inside the plant tops?
ga: Mɛni kɛ buji bibii lɛ baa? yɛ ŋmãa baai kɛ muji ni tsuɔ tamɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni yɔɔ tsei ashishifãi amli lɛ mli

english: This damage is caused by Fall Armyworm caterpillars that hide inside the central funnel of the plant, chewing on new leaves before they fully open.
ga: Fall Armyworm ŋmeii ni kɛ amɛhe ewo tso lɛ teŋgbɛ ŋmeii lɛ amli lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ nɛkɛ fitemɔ nɛɛ baa. ni amɛyeɔ baai heei dani amɛgbeleɔ kwraa.

english: Why do some of my cassava stem cuttings fail to grow after I plant them in the soil?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi yucca tsei lɛ ekomɛi nyɛɛɛ akwɛ̃ beni mikɛ amɛ ewo shikpɔŋ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ?

english: Cassava stems have small buds that must point upward; if planted upside down, the shoots struggle to reach the surface, causing the stem to rot under the ground.
ga: Kasava tso lɛ yɛ ŋmeii bibii. ni esa akɛ etsɔɔ ŋwɛi Kɛji akɛ adu lɛ ŋwɛigbɛ lɛ, ŋmeii lɛ baabɔ mɔdɛŋ ni amɛshɛ nu lɛ hiɛ. Enɛ haa tso lɛ tso lɛ fiteɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi.
